title: Hiring: SEO Content Writer – Remote
description:
**Position:** SEO Content Writer  

**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote (Work From Home)  

**Location:** Philippines  

**Salary:**  (depending on experience)  

**Working Hours:** 45 hours per week  

**Industry:** SEO / Digital Marketing / 

## About the Role



We are looking for a skilled, creative, and detail-oriented **SEO Content Writer** to join our growing SEO team.



The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, a good understanding of search engine optimisation (SEO), and the ability to produce engaging, well-researched, and original content that performs well in search engines.



You will be responsible for writing SEO-optimised blog articles, website landing pages, product descriptions, and other content designed to improve organic search visibility, attract relevant traffic, and support our overall SEO strategy.





## Key Responsibilities



### 1. SEO Content Writing

- Write original, high-quality, SEO-optimised blog posts, articles, landing pages, and website content.

- Create informative, engaging, and easy-to-read content that matches the target audience's search intent.

- Follow provided content briefs, target keywords, article outlines, and editorial guidelines.

- Write compelling page titles, meta descriptions, headings, and introductory paragraphs.

- Naturally incorporate primary and secondary keywords without keyword stuffing.

- Maintain consistent tone, style, and messaging across different pages and content types.



### 2. Keyword Research & Content Optimisation

- Conduct basic keyword research and identify relevant topics and keyword opportunities.

- Understand search intent and organise content around the questions and needs of the target audience.

- Review competing articles and search results to identify content gaps and opportunities.

- Structure articles using appropriate headings (H1, H2, H3), internal links, and relevant references.

- Optimise existing articles and landing pages to improve readability, relevance, and organic search performance.

- Apply SEO best practices, including content structure, keyword placement, and on-page optimisation.



### 3. Content Research & Quality Assurance

- Research topics thoroughly using credible and relevant sources.

- Verify facts, statistics, product details, and other important claims before publication.

- Ensure all submitted content is original, accurate, grammatically correct, and free from plagiarism.

- Edit and proofread content before submission.

- Avoid repetitive, generic, overly promotional, or unnatural writing.

- Ensure content complies with editorial guidelines and applicable content policies.



### 4. Content Management & Reporting

- Organise content assignments and monitor deadlines.

- Maintain content trackers using Google Sheets or similar tools.

- Coordinate with the SEO team regarding content briefs, revisions, and optimisation requirements.

- Update existing articles when information becomes outdated.

- Provide regular progress reports on assigned writing tasks.

- Incorporate editorial feedback and complete revisions when necessary.



## Qualifications



**Required:**

- At least 1 year of experience in content writing, SEO writing, copywriting, or a related field.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.

- Ability to write natural, clear, engaging, and informative content.

- Basic understanding of SEO principles, keyword placement, and search intent.

- Strong online research, editing, and proofreading skills.

- Ability to follow content briefs and meet deadlines consistently.

- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.



**Preferred but Not Required:**

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or other SEO tools.

- Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems.

- Understanding of internal linking, content clusters, and topical authority.

- Familiarity with Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

- Experience updating existing content based on SEO performance data.



## Content Quality Expectations



We are looking for writers who can produce content that sounds natural, informative, and genuinely useful.



**We do not want articles that sound obviously AI-generated.**



AI tools may be used to assist with research, brainstorming, or proofreading when permitted, but writers must take responsibility for the originality, accuracy, and overall quality of their work.



Content must demonstrate:

- Natural, fluent English and clear communication.

- Strong understanding of the topic and target audience.

- Original insights and useful information.

- Well-organised paragraphs and logical structure.

- Appropriate keyword usage without unnecessary repetition.

- Minimal filler, generic statements, and repetitive phrasing.

- Accurate information and reliable research.



What we offer:

- Fully remote work arrangement.

- Consistent writing assignments.

- Clear content briefs and SEO guidance.

- Opportunity to develop advanced SEO, AEO, and GEO writing skills.

- Professional growth within an SEO and digital marketing team.

- Performance-based salary reviews.



## How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit the following:



1. Updated resume or CV.

2. A brief introduction describing your writing experience.

3. Links to at least 2–3 previously published articles or writing samples.

4. A short description of your SEO knowledge and tools you have used.

5. Your expected monthly salary.

6. Your earliest available start date.



### Writing Assessment



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid writing assessment to evaluate their research, writing style, SEO understanding, and ability to follow a content brief.



We value writers who can produce clear, helpful, and original content over those who simply generate large volumes of articles.



**Application Subject:** SEO Content Writer Application – [Your Name]



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

• Input client and loan data accurately into CRM systems and submit applications to lenders via the appropriate online portals.

• Act as the central point of contact for brokers, clients, and lenders throughout the application process, providing timely progress updates and addressing queries accurately.

• Follow up with lenders and/or clients via phone or email for updates and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with underwriters, brokers, and internal tea
mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Continuously develop and maintain knowledge of lender policies, products, and credit criteria through training and self-study.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Advise clients on funds required to complete settlement, and liaise with all relevant parties — solicitors, lenders, and agents — to ensure files are ready.

• Notify clients once settlement is booked, send settlement breakdowns, and complete the settlement checklist in the system.

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of Australian mortgage broking or lending experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian Mortgage CRM platforms (e.g., Mercury, MyCRM, Salestrekker, Flex)

• Strong understanding of lender credit policies, serviceability requirements, and loan structures.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management.

• High level of written and spoken English communication skills.

• Analytical mindset with strong numeracy skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a client-first approach.

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Assistant
description:
TikTok Shop Affiliate Assistant



About us

Enso Sensory is a fast-growing ecommerce brand with over seven years in business. Our mission is to help people build moments of calm through sound healing, mindfulness tools and meditation products. We're a small, fully remote team. We stay connected on Slack and care about results, not hours logged. Start your application with the word "Rockstar"; we only read applications that begin with it.



The role

• You'll start by supporting our TikTok Shop affiliate program: communicating with creators on TikTok DMs and 
, reviewing sample requests, tracking posted videos, and keeping our creator records accurate. You'll work directly with our Affiliate Manager.

• Much of this work is becoming automated and AI-assisted. As it does, your role grows: you'll research what's working on TikTok and create content for one of our brand accounts, both short videos and carousels.



Before you apply, read this

We work on TikTok, and TikTok changes fast. New features, trends and rules arrive every week, so our priorities do too. This role will keep evolving, and you'll often be asked to take on something new. If you prefer a fixed job description, this isn't the role for you.



We'll train you on our tools and processes. After that, we're looking for someone who:

• Checks her own work before sending it, and catches her own mistakes

• Adapts instructions to the situation instead of copying them word for word

• Runs a task on her own once trained, and asks focused questions when something is unclear

• Notices when something isn't working and suggests a better way

• Is eager to learn new tools and take on challenges



No experience? That's okay. We're open to beginners. Skills can be taught; what we value more is work ethic, perseverance, and bringing your own thinking to every task. Filipinos have a word for it: malasakit, caring about the work as if it were your own. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



Who you are

• You're eager to learn TikTok: content, trends and creator programs.

• You have excellent written and spoken English.

• You're organized and comfortable with spreadsheets, Slack and Google Docs.

• Bonus: You're personally into wellness and mindfulness, and you'd use our products yourself.

• Bonus: experience with TikTok Shop affiliates, creator programs, content creation or 
 communities.



Pay and details

• Full time 40 hours per week, remote, flexible hours

• Starting salary: $450 USD/month, with room for fast growth based on performance

• Reliable internet and availability for weekly team calls



How to apply

Send us a short note (3 to 4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for this role, including any experience you have with affiliate or creator management, TikTok Shop, or social media. Please attach your CV and include links to any TikTok content you've made, if you have some (TikTok content is not compulsory).

title: Compliance Officer (AI and Data), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained. 



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise clients. They need to know their data is safe and that our products meet European rules, so we are hiring someone whose full focus is compliance.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You make sure every product we ship is compliant and properly documented. You report to our Head of Operations and work closely with our Head of Technology and Head of Product.



- Compliance documentation: keep it current for every product and client project, including data flows, processing records, security measures and risk assessments

- Client agreements: prepare data processing agreements and answer client security questionnaires

- Regulation checks: check products against GDPR and the EU AI Act, and flag gaps early to the product owner

- Internal policies: maintain our policies on data retention, access management and i
 response, and make sure teams follow them

- AI model register: track which AI models and hosting locations each product uses, so we can answer client questions fast

- Audits: support audits and certification work, such as ISO 27001



We are an AI company, and we want someone who helps our clients use AI safely and with confidence. That doesn't mean saying yes to everything. Sometimes good advice is "yes, and here's how." Sometimes it's "not like this." We value both, and we want you to speak up when something is at risk.





What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of experience in compliance, data privacy, IT audit or information security

- Hands-on experience with GDPR, such as DPIAs, processing records or data processing agreements

- You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work, and can show us how

- A precise, structured way of working

- Excellent English communication, especially written

- Comfortable asking developers the right questions and turning technical answers into clear documentation





Nice-to-have:

- Hands-on experience with Claude and how it handles data, connectors and Anthropic's terms. This will make your application stand out.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act

- A certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar

- Experience at a software or SaaS company

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and how AI models are hosted

- Experience working with European clients



If you already know Claude well, that's a big advantage. If you don't, we will teach you. We are an Anthropic partner and work with Claude every day, so you'll learn how Claude handles data, how connectors work and what Anthropic's terms say. What we need from you first is a solid compliance foundation and real curiosity about the tools.



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to draft policies, compare regulations or prepare questionnaire answers, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the compliance function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real questions: work where AI, privacy and regulation meet

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the compliance function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your CV / resume

2. Optional: certifications, LinkedIn profile, or examples of policies or documentation you wrote (anonymized). 



 subject: "Compliance Officer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your application within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates get a short practical assignment

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like bringing structure where there is none yet

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and how regulation shapes it



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Have no hands-on experience with GDPR or information security



Ready to apply? Send your CV to 
 and 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Cybersecurity Lead (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want one person to own it end to end, set the standard, and be able to block a release.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. You start as our security lead and build this into a small department over time.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Own i
 response and a vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)

- Build security into a small department over time and set the rules the developers follow



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security sets policy, finds issues, checks the fixes, and has veto on releases.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 4 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in our stacks: TypeScript/React/Next, Python, .NET, Postgres

- Azure security experience

- Supabase experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You take ownership without being chased. This is a lead role, not an assistant role.

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the security function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real authority: you have veto on releases

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: build and lead a small security department

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into application security.

2. A finding you are proud of: Walk us through a real vulnerability you found. How did you find it, what was the impact, and how did you get it fixed? Leave out anything confidential.

3. Stopping a release: Tell us about a time you had to say "this can't go live yet". How did you explain it, and how did you get the team on your side?

4. Securing AI: An AI assistant at a client can read their documents and use tools through MCP. What are the main risks, including which model providers may see client data, and what would you check first?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application

Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, bug bounty profile, GitHub, LinkedIn, or an anonymized finding report you wrote



 subject: "Security Lead Application - [Your Name]"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



WHO SHOULD APPLY

Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like setting up structure where there is none yet

- Take ownership without being chased

- Are curious about AI and the new security risks it brings



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Don't have hands-on application security or pentesting experience



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to

 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Customer Support Specialist | Shopify Dropshipping Experience Required
description:
We run several online women’s fashion stores serving customers in Canada, Australia and Europe. We are looking for a full-time customer support specialist with direct experience handling customer emails for a Shopify dropshipping store.



Previous Shopify dropshipping customer support experience is required. Experience with women’s fashion dropshipping stores is strongly preferred.



ABOUT THE JOB

Our system prepares most customer replies using approved templates. You are the human check: you read the conversation, compare the reply with the order details and tracking, correct errors according to our written policies, and send the right answer.

You also follow up with our fulfilment partner when orders are delayed or something goes wrong. We provide training on our systems and policies, but you should already understand the everyday customer service challenges of dropshipping.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Check and send customer replies about orders, delivery delays, sizing, returns and address changes.

- Verify order details, tracking updates, dates and amounts before sending.

- Follow up on delayed orders and problem cases with our fulfilment partner throughDiscord

- Ask customers for photos or additional information when needed.

- Follow our written policies and flag cases that need an owner’s decision.

- Keep clear case notes and follow up until each issue is resolved.

- Make sure no customer email waits longer than 24 hours for a response.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of customer support experience with Shopify dropshipping stores.

- Women’s fashion dropshipping experience is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, sizing complaints, returns and refund requests.

- Strong attention to detail: you notice incorrect dates, amounts, products and tracking statuses.

- A calm, professional approach to upset customers.

- Ability to follow written procedures and work reliably without constant supervision.

- Stable internet, your own laptop and a quiet place to work.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Full time: 8 hours per day, at least 6 days per week.

- $4 USD per hour, approximately $830 per month based on 48 hours per week.

- Long-term position with training through written guides and videos.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with KIWI and answer every question below:

1. Which Shopify dropshipping stores have you worked for? Include the store names, website URLs, your role and the dates you worked there.

2. Did any of these stores sell women’s fashion? Which ones?

3. What customer support tasks did you personally handle, which tools did you use, and approximately how many tickets did you handle per day?

4. Describe one difficult customer case you personally resolved involving a delayed order, sizing complaint or return. What did you check, what action did you take, and what was the outcome?

5. Confirm that you are available for the schedule and hourly rate above. Include your time zone and earliest start date.



If a confidentiality agreement prevents you from naming a store, explain this and suggest another way to verify your experience. Please do not share customer information or confidential company records.

We will only consider applications that answer these questions and demonstrate relevant Shopify dropshipping customer support experience. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical assessment using fictional customer cases and our written policies.

title: Commercial Roofing Estimator
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Proven experience in Australian roofing estimating, preferably across commercial roofing, roof plumbing, and re-roofing projects



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join an established Australian roofing and roof plumbing business servicing residential and commercial properties across South Australia.



This role will be responsible for preparing accurate and commercially competitive estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for a range of roofing projects. The successful candidate will review project documentation, interpret roofing plans and specifications, complete material take-offs, obtain supplier and subcontractor pricing, and prepare detailed cost estimates.



The business provides a range of roofing services, including metal and tiled roof repairs, complete re-roofing, COLORBOND® roof installations, gutters and downpipes, roof plumbing, flashing, stormwater drainage, roof inspections, and emergency roofing works.



The ideal candidate will have hands-on Australian roofing estimating experience, a strong understanding of roofing materials and installation requirements, and the ability to accurately price projects from drawings, specifications, site information, and scopes of work.



This is a detail-oriented role requiring strong commercial awareness, excellent numerical skills, and the ability to manage multiple quotations and estimating requests while working closely with an Australian-based team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Roofing Estimating & Tender Preparation – Primary Focus

- Review architectural drawings, roofing plans, specifications, scopes of work, and tender documentation.

- Prepare detailed estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for residential and commercial roofing projects.

- Complete material take-offs for roofing sheets, tiles, flashings, gutters, downpipes, insulation, and associated accessories.

- Calculate roof areas, lengths, quantities, material requirements, and installation costs.

- Estimate costs for labour, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and other project-related expenses.

- Review project specifications to identify the appropriate roofing systems, materials, and installation requirements.

- Obtain and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations.

- Review quotations to ensure all inclusions, exclusions, quantities, and scope requirements are accurately captured.

- Identify missing information, discrepancies, potential scope gaps, and cost risks.

- Prepare detailed estimating worksheets, cost breakdowns, and supporting tender documentation.

- Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and commercial competitiveness before submission.

- Update estimates when drawings, specifications, or project requirements change.

- Manage multiple estimating requests while meeting quotation and tender deadlines.

2. Roofing Systems & Technical Estimating

- Estimate a range of roofing systems and associated works, including:

- COLORBOND® and metal roofing

- Tiled roofing

- Metal roof replacements and upgrades

title: Rebar Estimator – Residential & Commercial Construction
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Minimum 2 years of Australian reinforcing steel estimating experience



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking an experienced Rebar Estimator to support an established Australian steel reinforcing business servicing residential and commercial construction projects.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience interpreting Australian construction and structural drawings, calculating reinforcing steel quantities, and preparing accurate material take-offs for concrete reinforcement projects.



The primary focus will be estimating reinforcing steel requirements for residential and commercial developments, including reinforcing bar, reinforcing mesh, and associated accessories. You will work with construction drawings and project specifications to determine reinforcement quantities, identify requirements, and provide accurate estimating information to support quotations, scheduling, and project delivery.



The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of Australian reinforcing steel practices, be comfortable working with structural and engineering drawings, and understand how reinforcement requirements translate into material quantities and project costs.



This is a practical, detail-oriented role for someone who can work independently, manage multiple projects, and deliver accurate estimates while collaborating with an Australian team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Rebar Estimating & Material Take-Offs – Primary Focus

- Review architectural, structural, and engineering drawings to identify reinforcing steel requirements.

- Prepare detailed material take-offs for residential and commercial construction projects.

- Calculate reinforcing bar quantities, lengths, sizes, and weights based on drawings and specifications.

- Estimate reinforcing mesh quantities and associated requirements.

- Identify the reinforcing steel products, grades, sizes, and accessories required for each project.

- Calculate quantities for reinforcement used in concrete slabs, footings, beams, columns, walls, and other reinforced concrete elements, where applicable.

- Review drawings and specifications to identify reinforcement details and project-specific requirements.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential issues that could affect quantities or estimates.

- Prepare accurate estimating worksheets, quantity summaries, and supporting documentation.

- Assist with preparing quotations and pricing information based on calculated quantities and applicable material costs.

- Review estimates for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.

- Assist with revisions to estimates when drawings, specifications, or project requirements change.

- Manage multiple estimating requests while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy.

2. Drawing Interpretation & Technical Support

- Read and interpret Australian structural and engineering drawings relevant to reinforcing steel.

- Understand reinforcement symbols, bar sizes, spacing, cover requirements, laps, and other relevant detailing information.

- Identify reinforcement requirements across different elements of residential and commercial concrete structures.

- Review reinforcement schedules and bar details where provided.

- Cross-check quantities against drawings, specifications, and available schedules.

- Recognise when reinforcement details are unclear, incomplete, or inconsistent and raise queries for clarification.

- Understand the relationship between reinforcement design, material quantities, cutting and bending requirements, and supply.

- Communicate technical questions and discrepancies to the relevant estimating, detailing, or project team members.

3. Reinforcing Products & Scheduling Support

- Identify the appropriate reinforcing bar, mesh, and accessories required for each project.

- Prepare and organise take-off information to support downstream scheduling and order preparation.

- Work with schedulers and other team members to clarify quantities and reinforcement requirements.

- Provide accurate quantity information to support bar bending schedules and reinforcing steel supply requirements.

- Review available schedules and supporting documents for consistency with drawings and specifications.

- Assist with updating quantity information when revised drawings or project changes are received.

- Maintain organised records of take-offs, revisions, and project documentation.

4. Project Coordination & Team Support

- Work closely with estimators, schedulers, and other relevant team members.

- Communicate progress, outstanding information, and potential estimating issues proactively.

- Follow up on missing drawings, specifications, or project details required to complete estimates.

- Maintain accurate records of estimating work and project revisions.

- Manage competing priorities while meeting agreed turnaround times.

- Support continuous improvements in estimating accuracy, consistency, and workflow efficiency.

- Collaborate with the Australian team through online meetings,
, and other communication channels.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 2 years of experience in reinforcing steel (rebar) estimating.

- Experience working with Australian residential and/or commercial construction projects.

- Demonstrated experience preparing reinforcing steel material take-offs from structural and engineering drawings.

- Strong understanding of reinforcing bar, reinforcing mesh, and associated accessories.

- Ability to calculate reinforcement quantities, lengths, sizes, and weights accurately.

- Ability to interpret structural drawings, reinforcement details, specifications, and schedules.

- Understanding of reinforcement requirements for common reinforced concrete elements, such as slabs, footings, beams, columns, and walls.

- Familiarity with Australian construction documentation and reinforcing steel practices.

- Strong numerical skills and attention to detail.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and digital estimating tools.

- Ability to manage multiple estimating tasks and meet deadlines.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Proactive approach to identifying discrepancies and seeking clarification.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating with an Australian team remotely.

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

- Experience estimating reinforcing steel for both residential and commercial projects.

- Experience with multi-storey residential developments, commercial buildings, or other reinforced concrete projects.

- Familiarity with bar bending schedules and reinforcement scheduling processes.

- Experience working with reinforcing steel suppliers, processors, or construction businesses.

- Knowledge of Australian reinforcing steel standards and relevant project specifications.

- Experience with digital take-off, CAD, or reinforcement estimating software.

- Experience handling drawing revisions and updating take-offs throughout the estimating process.

- Experience coordinating with schedulers, detailers, project managers, or construction teams.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The successful candidate will become a reliable estimating resource who helps the team prepare accurate, timely, and consistent reinforcing steel estimates.



Success means:

- Producing accurate reinforcing steel take-offs from Australian structural drawings.

- Correctly identifying reinforcing bar, mesh, and accessory requirements.

- Understanding the reinforcement requirements of residential and commercial concrete projects.

- Identifying discrepancies and missing information before they affect estimates or orders.

- Providing well-organised quantity information to support scheduling and supply.

- Managing multiple estimating requests while meeting deadlines.

- Communicating clearly with the Australian team and raising issues proactively.

- Maintaining consistent accuracy across estimates, revisions, and supporting documentation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Support residential and commercial construction projects across the Australian market.

- Work with an established Australian reinforcing steel business.

- Develop your expertise in reinforcing steel estimating and construction documentation.

- Collaborate with an experienced team across estimating, scheduling, and project support.

- Long-term opportunity within a technically focused and collaborative environment.

title: Full-Time Senior Bookkeeper | AU
description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



1. You do not have at least 5 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. General accounting experience outside Australia does not count towards this requirement.



2. You have never independently managed Australian payroll, including employee setup, weekly payroll processing, PAYG withholding and superannuation.



3. You are not confident with Australian GST, BAS and other relevant taxation requirements.



4. You do not have strong, hands-on experience using Xero, including bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable.



5. You have no practical experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.



6. You require constant supervision, regular reminders or step-by-step instructions to manage your daily responsibilities.



7. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where accuracy, urgency and accountability are essential.



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll.

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation.

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break (unpaid)

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

Most editors get a script, edit it and move on. Here you work with an experienced performance marketing team, see real ad results, and learn what makes direct-response creative work. You get modern AI production tools, regular feedback, and a path to Senior Video Editor or Creative Strategist.

title: Senior Manager, Commercial Learning and Development

title: On-Call Personal & Property Assistant – UK Property Business (ad hoc, 2–15 hrs/week, works alongside another job)
description:
On-Call Personal & Property Assistant for a UK property business: ad hoc, usually 2–15 hours a week



About us

We're a small, family-run UK property business that lets houses, rooms and studios. The owner wants a dependable assistant for the property side and for some personal admin, which is why this is a combined personal and property assistant role. He has other businesses too, but they won't be your focus. He has worked with remote assistants for several years.



How we work: led by AI, powered by a person

AI agents already run much of our day-to-day work. They triage the inboxes, draft and send
s and WhatsApp messages (sometimes on your behalf, sometimes on their own account), track tasks and follow set routines for lettings and property management. You'll work mainly with two of these agents. They'll brief you, tell you what needs doing and support you as you go.



What they can't replace is a sensible, reliable person. You will be:



• The eyes and brain. Bring common sense to what the AI is doing. Spot anything that looks wrong or unusual, help it get past blockers, and check that it's following its routines and doing its repeat work reliably.

• The hands. Make and take phone calls, make judgement calls, and do the things a person can do more easily, quickly or better, including the times when a personal, human touch matters.



AI will assist and lead the work, but the right person will always be an important part of how we operate. You don't need to be a UK property expert. You do need to be dependable and switched on, and comfortable working with AI tools.



What we're looking for, honestly. We hire a person for what AI can't do well: real judgement, overseeing the AI and spotting its gaps and mistakes, and being a real human voice on the phone. People like knowing there's a person behind our messages. We'll be judging this. If someone would only be doing what an AI could do, it won't be the right fit. We want someone who enjoys working alongside AI and filling its gaps, not someone frustrated by it.



When we need you

This is ad hoc work, not a fixed shift. Most weeks it's somewhere between 2 and 15 hours, depending on what's going on with the properties (lettings, viewings, repairs) and with the owner's personal admin and travel. Many of our best candidates have another job or clients, and that's fine.



What matters is that you stay reachable through the UK day, from your phone and your computer (we're busiest roughly 9am–5:30pm UK time, which is 5pm–1:30am Philippine time in UK winter), and that you triage well. An
 often doesn't need an answer for hours. A tenant WhatsApp may need a reply in minutes. A viewer phoning because they can't find the property needs you now. Judging what needs what response, while you get on with your day, is the core skill.



Phone calls. This isn't a call-heavy job. We encourage everyone to use WhatsApp and
, and the more responsive you are there, the fewer calls you'll get. But some calls can't wait, and these are the times you must keep your phone close:



• Viewing blocks, for example 90 minutes of back-to-back viewings, when people may have access problems, need the full address, or call to make an offer.

• Access windows, when a contractor or cleaner is going into a property and a tenant needs to let them in.



You'll usually know about these windows in advance. We're also planning to add an AI that answers calls first, deals with the simple ones, takes messages for non-urgent ones, and only puts through the calls that need a person.



The most important thing is good triage and reliable responsiveness: seeing things quickly on WhatsApp and
, judging what needs action now and what can wait, and being by the phone during the windows we agree in advance.



Weekend work is occasional, mainly messages with the owner, a viewing day, a tenant issue, or helping with his personal plans. You'll usually know in advance when you need to be especially available. Work comes in short bursts of ad hoc tasks, not long fixed shifts.



What we provide



• A work phone number on a VoIP app that rings on both your phone and your computer. We pay for the line. You'll use it to call UK numbers and to take incoming calls.

• WhatsApp, which we use heavily for messaging.

• Google Workspace, and AI agents to brief you and draft for you.



What you'll do



• Phone calls to UK numbers: contractors such as plumbers, electricians and other trades, letting agents, suppliers, utility companies, councils (when approved) and tenants. You'll get a short brief before each call and report back afterwards on what was agreed.

• Incoming calls on the work number when needed, such as during viewings or access windows.

• Messaging tenants, applicants and contractors by WhatsApp and
, following our scripts and rules.

• Arranging contractors and viewings: booking slots, confirming access and attendance, and chasing.

• Following up: making sure what was promised actually happens (repairs, quotes, documents, payments), and flagging it when it doesn't.

• Overseeing the AI: checking its drafts, lists and records, making sure it keeps to its routines, and speaking up when something looks off.

• Light admin: filing and simple updates in Google Sheets and Docs.

• Personal assistant tasks for the owner: booking appointments, calling companies on his behalf, chasing deliveries and refunds, and other everyday admin.



Requirements



• Good spoken English. You'll need to be clear and confident on UK phone calls and able to follow UK accents.

• Good written English for messages and notes (the AI agents help with drafting).

• Availability: tell us when you're usually reachable, in UK time, Monday to Sunday. If you have another job or clients (that's fine), tell us their hours and how you'd keep an eye on WhatsApp and
 around them. Could you keep your phone free for a pre-arranged 60–90 minute window, such as a viewing block, on most weekdays?

In it: (a) introduce yourself and say when you're available in UK time; and (b) act out this call in your own words. You're phoning a plumber for a landlord client about a leaking kitchen tap at one of his rental flats. Find out their earliest availability this week and their call-out charge, and explain that the tenant can give access after 2pm.

Pay and start: you'll be paid by the hour, at your agreed rate, for the work you do. There's no retainer and no minimum hours. You'll keep a simple log of your tasks and time and bill from it. We'd prefer an immediate start, but we can be flexible.

We’re looking for a hands-on SEO and WordPress professional to lead website migrations, manage a team, and oversee high-volume content production for a nationwide healthcare brand with locations across the U.S. A major part of this role is making each location’s content relevant to the patients, families, and communities it serves.

- Own website and domain migrations.  Crawl sites before and after launch, build old-to-new URL maps, implement *301 redirects, and test for broken links, redirect chains, and issues affecting priority pages.



- Track local SEO and organic performance.* Monitor location-level rankings, search performance, and organic conversions. Use reporting to identify gaps and prioritize fixes.



- Oversee editorial quality.* Use writing and optimization tools to support production. Personally review content for accuracy, originality, readability, and brand voice. Flag healthcare claims that need clinical review before publication.



- Keep projects organized in Excel and Google Sheets.* Track URLs, redirects, keywords, anchor text, assignments, deadlines, and publication status. Keep trackers current so the team knows who owns each task and what’s due next.



- Lead and influence a team.* Delegate work, set clear expectations, give actionable feedback, and follow through on deadlines. Build buy-in and resolve blockers while keeping multiple projects moving.

| **Content writing, editing, and optimization** | Google Docs, Grammarly, QuillBot, ZeroGPT, Surfer SEO, Copyscape |

| **Tracking and project management** | Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and a project management platform such as Asana, ClickUp, or 
 |



 What we’re looking for



- **7+ years of relevant experience** in SEO, WordPress, or digital marketing, including experience managing people and projects.

- Hands-on expertise with **WordPress, Gutenberg, migrations, 301 redirects, local SEO, keyword research, anchor text, and SEO content writing.



- Strong **Excel skills**, including formulas, filters, lookups, and pivot tables.



- Strong written English and the ability to turn SEO research into clear, useful content for patients and families.



- Reliable attendance during the required U.S. Eastern hours, ownership of deadlines, and early communication when something could affect delivery.



- The resourcefulness to solve problems independently and handle a high volume of work while keeping the team organized and maintaining accuracy.

title: UK Accountant – Balance Sheet Review & Reconciliations (Xero)
description:
We're a London business group: Number 90, a bar, nightclub and events venue in Hackney Wick, and Mainyard Studios, a workspace business with 600+ residents. Mainyard runs each building as its own small company, and most of them are simple: rent in, costs out.



An external firm does most of our bookkeeping and set up our books, and a UK accountant reviews our accounts at year-end. That isn't changing. In-house, Erica handles our finance and credit control. She has grown with the business from building manager to running our numbers day to day.



We're looking for an accountant to join Erica. Your job is to catch problems before they reach our year-end accountant: balance sheet accounts that don't reconcile, payroll and tax payments posted to the wrong place, depreciation not posted, intercompany balances that don't agree. That frees Erica to focus on bigger things, such as negotiating deals.



If you can look at a balance sheet and tell us what's wrong with it, this role is for you.



What you'll do

• Review our companies' balance sheets every month and make sure every line ties to evidence: bank, PAYE, NIC, pensions, VAT, corporation tax, intercompany, loans and deposits

• Check the journals our bookkeeper and accountants post, and get the errors fixed

• Keep Xero up to date with our finance lead at Mainyard Studios: bank reconciliations, invoicing, chasing late payments and checking supplier bills

• Reconcile club nights at Number 90: promoter recharges, tech and PRS costs, supplier overcharges

• Build simple month-end checklists and help with budgets

There's plenty of hands-on reconciliation work. We want it done by someone who understands the whole balance sheet, not just the bank feed.



You must have

• A degree in Accountancy. CPA or audit experience is strongly preferred.

• 3+ years of balance sheet reconciliations and month-end close, ideally across several companies

• Daily, practical Xero experience

• UK experience: you've worked on UK clients' books, or you know UK VAT and payroll (PAYE and NIC) well enough to show us on the call

• Clear written English, and the habit of raising problems without being asked

Nice to have: Xero Advisor certification, hospitality or property experience.



Working hours

Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday. Flexible within the day, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping UK business hours.



Salary & benefits

• Base salary: $1,000 USD per month

• 13th-month pay, pro-rated in your first year

• 20 days' paid holiday a year, inclusive of Philippine public holidays

• Up to 5 paid sick days a year



After passing 3 months' probation:

• Company-funded health insurance

• A quarterly recovery bonus of up to 75% of a month's salary, for money you find and recover that we would otherwise have lost



How to apply

Please do not reply directly to this advert. Create a Google Drive folder titled Your Full Name + Your Superpower, and include:

1. A short video (2 minutes max). Who you are and why this role interests you. Mention your name and today's date. Not a spoken CV.

2. "The Mistake I Found" (10 lines max). A time you found an error someone else made in the accounts: what it was, how you found it, and what you changed so it didn't happen again. Your real experience, not a textbook answer.

3. Your CV, plus your Xero certificate if you have one.

4. Take your DISC profile using this disc and add it to the folder: 
/EndUserAdmin/RegisterMobile.aspx?}]xT



Share the folder with 
 and
 us the link.



What happens next: shortlisted candidates have a video call where we share a real balance sheet on screen and ask what you'd question. There's no preparation needed. If you know balance sheets, you'll enjoy it.



We use TimeProof for all working hours. It's not there to spy on you. It shows us how long tasks really take, so we can improve our processes. Split your day however suits you, as long as you cover the UK overlap and you're focused on us while you're working. If you're not comfortable with TimeProof, please don't apply.



Finish your application
 with the words Numbers Don't Lie, so we know you've read the whole advert.

- Manage audience interactions related to promotions, webinar registrations, product launches, and marketing campaigns.

- Utilize approved direct-message automation tools, such as ManyChat, to support lead generation and customer engagement.

- Monitor brand sentiment and identify potential reputation management concerns.



### 4. Social Media Growth & Optimization



- Develop strategies to increase followers, impressions, reach, engagement, video views, and qualified audience growth.

- Analyze audience demographics, behavior, and content preferences to refine platform strategies.

- Optimize YouTube content through effective titles, thumbnails, descriptions, keywords, playlists, and audience retention analysis.

- Identify opportunities for collaborations, influencer partnerships, and cross-platform promotion.

- Conduct competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, successful content approaches, and growth opportunities.

- Test content formats, publishing schedules, creative approaches, and calls to action to maximize performance.

- Build strategies that move audiences from social platforms into owned marketing channels, including
 lists, webinar registrations, and customer communities.



### 5. Webinar Development, Launch & Management



- Plan, build, launch, and manage live and evergreen webinars designed to educate audiences, generate leads, and drive product sales.

- Develop complete webinar promotional campaigns utilizing organic social media, paid advertising,
 marketing, and SMS communications.

- Create and optimize webinar registration pages, confirmation pages, reminder sequences, and post-event follow-up communications.

- Coordinate webinar schedules, promotional assets, registration systems, technical setup, and campaign execution.

- Work with clients and presenters to develop compelling webinar messaging, offers, presentations, and conversion strategies.

- Manage platforms such as Zoom Webinars, WebinarJam, EverWebinar, GoHighLevel, or similar solutions.

- Develop strategies for paid workshops, multi-day challenges, masterclasses, and digital product launches.

- Analyze webinar performance, including registration rates, attendance rates, audience retention, offer conversion rates, cost per registrant, and revenue.

- Optimize webinar campaigns based on measurable performance data.



### 6. Sales Funnel Development & Marketing Automation

- Build landing pages, opt-in forms, sales pages, checkout pages, and thank-you pages.

- Create automated

- Integrate social media campaigns with CRM systems,

- Utilize platforms such as GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Kajabi, HubSpot, or similar tools.

- Implement segmentation, lead tagging, workflow triggers, and customer journey automation.

- Develop conversion strategies for low-ticket digital products, mid-ticket programs, and high-ticket coaching, consulting, and educational offers.

- Continuously monitor and improve funnel conversion rates.



### 7. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management



- Develop, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Create paid advertising strategies supporting brand awareness, content distribution, audience growth, lead generation, webinar registrations, and product sales.

- Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, retargeting strategies, ad placements, and creative testing.

- Develop advertising copy and collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing ad assets.

- Track performance across the customer journey, from content discovery to lead generation and sales.

- Identify high-performing content and recommend strategies to replicate successful results.

- Analyze underperforming campaigns and develop corrective action plans.

- Present clear, actionable recommendations to internal leadership and clients.

- Connect digital marketing activity to measurable business results, including lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue.



### 9. Client Communication & Project Management

- Manage multiple client campaigns without compromising quality or consistency.

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardized processes, and emerging technologies.

Manage advertising budgets responsibly and efficiently

Stay updated on platform changes, industry trends, and best practices

Minimum 2 years of media buying experience within a marketing agency environment

Strong understanding of lead generation campaigns and performance marketing fundamentals

Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign data

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English



Applications that do not meet the above requirements will not be considered.



About You

Comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

Strong understanding of customer psychology, sales funnels, and conversion optimization

Proactive problem solver who can work independently

Able to think strategically while executing tactically

Thrives in a fast-paced agency environment

Passionate about digital marketing and continuous learning

Experience managing advertising budgets exceeding SGD $30,000/month

Experience with CRM systems, attribution tools, and marketing automation platforms

Copywriting experience for direct response advertising

Familiarity with landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO)

Opportunity to manage campaigns for exciting and fast-growing brands

Direct exposure to high-growth marketing strategies and scaling frameworks

Fast-paced agency environment with significant opportunities for growth

Collaborative team culture focused on performance and results

Access to training, mentorship, and hands-on experience across multiple industries

Opportunity to play a key role in shaping client growth and business outcomes
