title: Ad Designer ($4 to $20/hour + Bonuses on Winning Ads)
description:
Fully Remote | Long-term Contractor | Min 15 hrs/week, full-time possible | $4 to $20 USD/hour + up to $500 bonus per image



About Us

We sell unique, personalized jewelry, gifts and travel products online. Your work is judged on one thing: does the ad sell. Your ads run for real products with real ad spend behind them. Many of our team members have been with us for 2+ years.



Pay

The pay range for this role is listed below. It covers your total earnings: your hourly base pay plus the bonuses you earn on winning ads.

- Total pay: $4 to $20 USD/hour, plus up to $500 per image in bonuses

- Base: set by your experience, then reviewed after 4 to 6 weeks and raised as your ads win

- Bonuses: paid on top, based on how much ad spend your images get

- Growth path: everyone can grow to $20/hour. Top performers can also move up to help lead other designers.



What You'll Do

- Design static image ads for Meta in many styles: offer images, headline ads, gifting and lifestyle scenes

- Build every ad in Figma in the sizes we need: 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16

- Take a reference ad and rebuild its structure for our products

- Make new versions of winning ads: new hooks, headlines and products, same layout

- Use AI tools to create product scenes that look real

- Add headlines and text yourself so they feel like part of the image

- Share a quick daily update with the team



Who This Is For

- You've designed ads, product images or social posts (show us the ads)

- Must be comfortable in Figma, which is where you'll build every ad

- Strong typography: most of our ads have text, so layout and font choices matter

- A good eye for detail, so products look like the real thing, and good written English



Nice to Have

- Higgsfield or other AI image tools (we'll train you)

- Photoshop basics: clean cutouts and simple retouching

- Experience with brand guidelines or ads for online stores



Working Style

- Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

- Location: 100% remote, set your own hours

- Hours: Minimum 15 hrs/week, more if you want (full-time possible)



Sound like a fit? Apply with links to ads or designs you've made.

title: Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)
description:
Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)

 

Company: Samba Soccer Schools Global Ltd

 

Location: Remote – Philippines

 

Salary: $800 USD per month 

 

Working Days: Monday–Friday

 

Working Hours: 6:00am–3:00pm UK time (2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time), including a 1-hour break.

 

Position: Full-time, long-term, exclusive — we will be your only client.

 

ABOUT SAMBA SOCCER SCHOOLS

 

Samba Soccer Schools is a growing UK-based children's football coaching organisation. We have coached over 20,000 children across London in the last 15 years, and we are now expanding across the UK through both our company-owned operating business and a network of independently operated franchise businesses.

 

As our franchise network continues to expand, we are looking for an experienced, proactive and commercially minded finance professional to join our team.

 

This person will be responsible for supporting the financial operations of both our main operating business and our franchise network, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, effective financial management, consistent reporting and strong financial performance.

 

You will work closely with the Managing Director, our UK accountants and individual franchise partners.

 

This is not simply a bookkeeping or data-entry position.

 

We want someone who understands how businesses operate financially, can interpret financial information, identify problems early, recommend improvements and help franchise partners become more financially successful.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

1. MAIN OPERATING BUSINESS – FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT

 

You will help manage the day-to-day financial operations of Samba Soccer Schools' main operating business.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records using Xero.

 

Completing monthly bank reconciliations.

 

Monitoring revenue, expenditure, invoices and supplier payments.

 

Tracking accounts payable and receivable.

 

Monitoring company cash flow and preparing forecasts.

 

Reviewing monthly profit and loss statements.

 

Tracking budgets and identifying overspending.

 

Monitoring recurring costs, subscriptions and supplier expenses.

 

Identifying cost-saving opportunities.

 

Preparing weekly and monthly financial summaries for the Managing Director.

 

Working with our external UK accountants to ensure accurate financial records and compliance, including preparing the workings for VAT returns for their review.

 

2. FRANCHISE NETWORK – MONTHLY BOOKKEEPING

 

You will also be responsible for managing and coordinating the monthly bookkeeping requirements across our growing network of franchise businesses.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Maintaining bookkeeping records for individual franchisees using Xero.

 

Completing monthly bank reconciliations for franchise businesses.

 

Ensuring income and expenditure are correctly categorised.

 

Reviewing transactions and investigating discrepancies.

 

Monitoring outstanding invoices and financial commitments.

 

Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and on time each month.

 

Maintaining consistent charts of accounts across franchise businesses.

 

Working with our external accountants to ensure records are accurate and ready for statutory and tax reporting.

 

Each franchise must have accurate, organised and up-to-date financial information.

 

3. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL ONBOARDING

 

When new franchise partners join Samba Soccer Schools, you will take responsibility for supporting the financial onboarding process.

 

This includes:

 

Guiding franchisees through the financial setup of their businesses.

 

Coordinating the setup and configuration of Xero.

 

Ensuring the correct chart of accounts is implemented.

 

Supporting the setup of bank feeds and accounting processes.

 

Explaining how franchisees should manage income, expenditure and financial records.

 

Educating new franchisees on bookkeeping responsibilities and financial procedures.

 

Ensuring each franchise follows our standardised reporting structure.

 

Liaising with franchisees and accountants to resolve financial setup issues.

 

Our goal is for every franchise partner to start their business with the correct financial systems, processes and understanding in place.

 

4. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE MONITORING

 

A major part of this role involves actively monitoring the financial performance of our franchise network.

 

You will:

 

Review monthly revenue, operating costs and profitability for each franchise.

 

Monitor profit margins and overall financial health.

 

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

 

Identify franchisees experiencing financial difficulties.

 

Monitor trends in revenue, expenses and profitability.

 

Analyse venue-level profitability where data is available.

 

Identify unnecessary costs and opportunities to improve financial performance.

 

Track outstanding franchise fees, royalties and other financial obligations.

 

Produce meaningful financial insights and recommendations.

 

We want someone who can look at financial reports and explain what the numbers mean, why performance is changing and what action should be taken.

 

5. MONTHLY FRANCHISE FINANCIAL REPORTING

 

You will be responsible for preparing and distributing monthly financial performance reports to franchise partners.

 

Each report should provide a clear overview of the franchise's financial performance, including:

 

Monthly revenue.

 

Operating expenditure.

 

Gross and net profitability.

 

Profit margins.

 

Cash-flow position.

 

Performance against budgets or previous periods.

 

Significant changes in income or expenditure.

 

Areas of financial concern.

 

Recommendations to improve profitability.

 

Reports must be accurate, easy to understand and consistent across the franchise network.

 

You will also provide the Managing Director with a consolidated overview of franchise financial performance.

 

6. FINANCIAL EDUCATION & FRANCHISE SUPPORT

 

We want our franchise partners to become financially knowledgeable and capable business owners.

 

You will play an important role in developing their financial understanding and commercial awareness.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Helping franchisees understand their profit and loss statements.

 

Explaining the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.

 

Educating franchisees on budgeting and financial planning.

 

Helping franchisees understand their operating costs and profit margins.

 

Explaining how to identify unnecessary expenditure.

 

Supporting franchisees with financial questions.

 

Helping franchisees understand how financial decisions affect profitability.

 

Providing practical recommendations to improve business performance.

 

You must be confident explaining financial concepts in simple, clear English to people who may not have an accounting background.

 

7. EARLY IDENTIFICATION OF FINANCIAL PROBLEMS

 

One of the most important responsibilities of this position is identifying financial problems before they become serious.

 

You will be expected to proactively monitor the finances of both our operating business and franchise network.

 

Examples include:

 

A franchise consistently operating at a loss.

 

Rapidly increasing operating costs.

 

Significant reductions in revenue.

 

Poor cash-flow management.

 

Unpaid invoices or overdue financial obligations.

 

Unusual transactions or financial discrepancies.

 

Potential cash shortages.

 

Franchisees spending beyond their available budgets.

 

Unexpected changes in profitability.

 

Any significant financial concern must be flagged directly to the Managing Director as early as possible, together with an explanation of the issue and recommended actions.

 

We do not want someone who simply reports financial problems after they have happened.

 

We want someone proactive who can anticipate risks and help prevent them.

 

8. FINANCIAL REPORTING & MANAGEMENT DASHBOARDS

 

You will also help develop and maintain financial reporting systems for the wider business.

 

This includes:

 

Preparing monthly management accounts.

 

Maintaining cash-flow forecasts.

 

Creating Excel or Google Sheets financial dashboards.

 

Monitoring key financial performance indicators.

 

Producing weekly financial summaries for management.

 

Comparing performance across franchise businesses.

 

Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

Supporting the Managing Director with financial analysis and business decisions.

 

We are an AI-forward business: we use modern AI tools throughout our financial workflows, and we will train you on our systems. An interest in working this way is important.

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

Minimum 2–3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

 

Previous experience supporting UK businesses, including familiarity with UK VAT and UK accounting practices.

 

Strong hands-on experience using Xero.

 

Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients.

 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

 

Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.

 

Experience with bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.

 

Good understanding of budgeting, profitability and cash-flow management.

 

Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 

Excellent attention to detail.

 

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.

 

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

 

Accounting qualification (CPA) or relevant university degree.

 

Experience at an outsourcing/BPO firm serving UK accounting practices.

 

Experience working with franchise businesses or multi-location companies.

 

Experience preparing management accounts and financial dashboards.

 

Experience supporting business owners with financial planning.

 

Experience training or explaining financial concepts to non-finance professionals.

 

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

We are looking for someone who is:

 

Highly organised, reliable and trustworthy.

 

Confident working with financial information.

 

Proactive rather than reactive.

 

Commercially minded and interested in business performance.

 

Comfortable communicating directly with business owners.

 

Able to explain complicated financial information simply.

 

Confident identifying problems and recommending solutions.

 

Capable of managing multiple businesses and deadlines.

 

Interested in building a long-term career with our company.

 

We value initiative, ownership and accountability.

 

If you notice a problem, we want you to raise it.

 

If you identify an opportunity to improve profitability, we want you to recommend it.

 

If a franchise partner is struggling financially, we want you to help them understand why and what they can do about it.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

$800 USD monthly salary, paid monthly via Wise.

 

Salary reviews after 6 and 12 months, based on performance.

 

Consistent full-time Monday–Friday schedule on a standard Philippine mid shift (2:00pm–11:00pm).

 

Long-term opportunity with a growing UK company.

 

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director.

 

Opportunity to work across multiple businesses.

 

Exposure to franchise operations and business financial management.

 

Clear potential for career progression as the franchise network grows.

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:

 

1. How many years of bookkeeping or accounting experience do you have?

 

2. How many years have you used Xero professionally?

 

3. Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients simultaneously?

 

4. Describe your experience working with UK-based businesses, including any UK VAT work.

 

5. Can you independently prepare monthly management accounts, profit and loss statements and cash-flow forecasts?

 

6. Have you ever monitored the financial performance of a business and recommended improvements? Give a brief example.

 

7. Are you comfortable explaining financial reports to business owners who do not have an accounting background?

 

8. Have you supported the financial onboarding or accounting setup of new businesses?

 

9. This is a full-time, exclusive role. Are you able to commit 100% of your working time to us, with no other clients?

 

10. Are you available to work 2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time (6:00am–3:00pm UK time), Monday–Friday?

 

11. Are you happy with the salary of $800 USD per month pay?

 

12. When would you be available to start?

 

Please attach your CV and, if possible, an anonymised example of a financial report or dashboard you have previously prepared.

 

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "SAMBA FINANCE" so we know you have read the full job description.

 

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online interview and a paid practical finance assessment using real (anonymised) company data.

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Shopify Migration Recovery & Ongoing Optimization (Long-Term) – SewingMachinesPlus.com
description:
is an established Shopify store selling sewing machines, fabric, and related products. In February we migrated our store to Shopify, and our organic traffic and keyword rankings have fallen off a cliff since. Pages that used to drive strong traffic lost their rankings, redirects were not mapped correctly, and the site still has broken, thin, and duplicate pages hurting indexation and crawl efficiency.



We need a senior, hands-on SEO specialist with deep technical SEO and migration recovery experience who can understand everything that went wrong post-migration and get our rankings and traffic back. This is a long-term position, but we want to start with a focused recovery sprint: a lot of hours up front for the right person who can show they can get the site back up.



Phase 1 – Audit and recovery plan (first step):

- Run a full technical SEO audit and migration analysis of the site at the start, so we are all on the same page and have a clear, prioritized plan

- Compare pre- and post-migration URLs, traffic, and keyword rankings (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, Wayback/old sitemaps) to find exactly what was lost and why

- Deliver a written recovery roadmap with priorities, timelines, and expected impact



What you will do:

- Build and implement a complete 301 redirect map so every old URL points to the right new page (no redirect chains, loops, or soft 404s)

- Find and fix crawl errors, 404s, broken internal links, orphan pages, and duplicate or thin content

- Clean up indexation: XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, noindex rules, and Google Search Console coverage issues

- Reorganize site architecture, collection structure, and internal linking so authority flows to our most important pages

- Check domain, DNS, and HTTPS/www setup for misconfigurations affecting crawling or indexing

- On-page optimization: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, collection and product page copy, image alt text, and structured data (schema)

- Keyword recovery and keyword mapping for collection and product pages

- Review the backlink profile and recover lost link equity from old URLs

- Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed where they affect rankings

- Track and report weekly on rankings, organic traffic, indexation, and progress against the plan



What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with strong technical SEO skills

- Proven Shopify SEO experience, including at least one platform migration or migration recovery (please name the site)

- Expert with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a crawler such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb

- Deep understanding of 301 redirects, redirect mapping, canonicalization, indexation, and site architecture

- Strong on-page SEO and e-commerce keyword research skills

- Clear written English and the ability to explain issues and plans in plain language

- Available for heavy hours during the initial recovery sprint, then steady long-term work



How to apply:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, include:

1. One real before/after SEO result, with the site name, ideally a migration or traffic recovery

2. Your Shopify SEO experience and the tools you use

3. How you would approach the first week of auditing a site whose traffic dropped after a migration

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small paid test task.

title: Remote Sales Rep, Quote Calls & Bookings (Full-Time, Mon–Fri, Base + Commission)
description:
Keep It Tidy Home Care is a fast-growing residential and commercial cleaning company in the GTA, Ontario. We’re looking for a friendly, quick-to-respond rep to turn new quote requests into booked cleans.

The job is simple:

Our leads come in from Meta ads and our website. When someone submits a quote, call them as fast as you can, ideally within 2 to 3 minutes.

Quotes that come in after 7 PM or on the weekend: call first thing the next business morning (11 AM, Monday to Thursday).

Expect about 5–6 calls a day. Quick, friendly conversations.

Give the quote from our pricing sheet and book the job on the call.

Log the booking details in our calendar: address, service, special instructions and cleaner slot.

Answer inbound calls and follow up by text when needed.

When you work:

Monday to Thursday, available 11 AM – 8 PM Eastern. No weekends. It’s not a full day of calls, but you need to be online and ready to call as soon as a quote comes in.

You’re a great fit if you:

Speak clear, natural, confident English and sound warm on the phone.

Respond fast and stay organized.

Have fast internet, a quiet space and a noise-canceling headset.

Have phone sales, appointment setting or scheduling experience (North American local service is a plus).

Pay Structure & Trial:

$15USD / Day (~$250-$300USD / month) guaranteed base pay.

10% Commission for every cleaning you book.

Example: On a standard $400–$455 deep or move-out clean, you earn your $15USD daily base plus an extra $40 to $45+ CAD (~$30+ USD) per booking.

1-Week Paid Trial: All new hires start with a 1-week paid trial evaluated strictly on speed-to-lead (calling new quotes within 2–3 minutes) and call quality/objection handling.

How to apply:

Send your resume plus a link to a 30-second audio intro (Google Drive, Vocaroo or Loom). Tell us about your phone sales and scheduling experience and let us hear how you sound. Applications without an audio link won’t be reviewed.

 content for clarity, formatting, quality, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

 content schedules and coordinate with relevant team members to ensure timely distribution.

description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs more.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

Support here runs around the clock, in three 8-hour shifts (Philippine time):

• Afternoon and evening: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM

• Graveyard: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM

• Morning: 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM

In the application form, tell us every shift you can work. We agree on yours together, and then it stays fixed.

Whatever your shift, the job is the same:

• You own the queue while you are on. Every customer gets an answer, every order problem gets followed.

• On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of the queue.

• Before you log off, you brief the next agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. One fixed day off, agreed together. It cannot be Saturday, Sunday or Monday.

• One fixed shift, agreed together (see the three shifts above): 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $1,000 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🕐 A fixed shift, chosen with you. No split shift, no schedule that changes every week.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.

In return: your salary grows over time, you earn performance bonuses, and you take on more responsibility as the brand grows.

Apply through this form:

1. Application form

3. You start. The first month is a paid trial, then it's a long-term role

title: US Tax Manager
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:

title: DTC Creative Strategist & DR Copywriter (Supplements, Native Ads)
description:
We're looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to join our team on a long-term, full-time contract! As our creative strategist, you'll own the ideation, research, copywriting, planning and management of the entire creative process, with a heavy focus on native image ads, Meta VSLs, UGC ads and high-converting direct response ads (short and long form) that scale across our paid channels. We spend $100,000 to $300,000 per month on Meta. We're looking for someone with 3+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in health and wellness, is a proven native ad killer, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs, and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.





WHO ARE WE?



We're a premium DTC supplement brand and one of the fastest-growing brands in our space: $300,000 to $400,000 per month in revenue and targeting 8 figures in 2027. We recently launched a new product line and are expanding into new customer avatars. We have our own in-house AI creative app for scripting, revisions and production, so your ideas get tested fast. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.





WHAT IS OUR CULTURE LIKE & WHO IS A GOOD FIT?



Hunger is our #1 factor when hiring. We have a genuine will to win, and no work is beneath us if it moves the brand forward. We're results-first: we care about what you ship and what it does, not when you're online. We make decisions with data, and we treat every problem as a chance to learn and get better.



If you want a comfortable, stress-free 9-5, this isn't it.



If you want to own creative at a brand that's scaling, work directly with the founder bouncing ideas back and forth every day, see huge career growth by playing a big part in scaling it to 8 figures, drive results without politics or corporate red tape, and make as much money as humanly possible doing it... then you've come to the right place.





KEY OBJECTIVES



• Manage the full creative process, from research and scripting all the way to final creative, to produce high-converting creatives on an ongoing basis

• Drive measurable improvements in our core advertising metrics through better creative

• Write all direct response copy: primary texts, hooks, VSL and UGC scripts, advertorials, listicles and product pages

• Run the full native image ad workflow, from the copy to the images

• Use performance data from Meta to dissect, analyze and iterate on our creatives so performance keeps improving

• Come up with new angles, mechanisms and concepts together with the founder

• Conduct strategic customer and competitor research: Meta Ad Library, reviews, Reddit, forums and X

• Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis

• D
 on the next steps needed to scale Meta further through better creative

• Produce a minimum of 15 new ads per week, maintaining volume and quality at the same time, without being chased





REQUIREMENTS



• Fully remote, independent contractor role: full-time commitment with complete flexibility on working hours

• Fluent in English

• Direct Response Expertise: 3+ years of performance creative for DTC health, wellness or supplement brands, or at a creative agency, is a must

• Native Killer: you've written native ads, advertorials and listicles that scaled, and you can show them

• Proven VSL copywriting experience on direct response / performance brands

• Meta VSLs: proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs

• Deep DTC Experience: you can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work, not just categories

• Strong analytical skills: hands-on experience reading performance data in Meta Ads Manager and attribution tools, and using spreadsheets and reporting tools to pull insights, inform strategy and communicate results

• You understand the levels of awareness and actually apply them

• Chronically Online: you naturally spend your time on X and scrolling through the Ad Library

• AI Stack: you run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once

• Output: you deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased

• No issue putting in extra hours or weekends when needed. You're passionate about your work and wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you worked less

• Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and to work closely with the founder

• Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands

• Growth Mindset: you're open to feedback and always learning. If you don't have the hunger and drive in you, don't apply.





EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Develop native ads end-to-end: angle, hook, primary text and images

• Develop VSL briefings end-to-end: angle, hook, script, structure

• Design AI-driven concepts and hooks for paid video

• Write advertorials and listicles that carry the ad's promise all the way to the sale

• Find winning ads in the Ad Library and adapt them for our avatars

• Partner with editors on testing, and iterate strategy based on creative performance data





HOW OUR HIRING WORKS & HOW WE OPERATE



We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates on our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has two stages:



1. Application Review + Screening: we review your background and experience to confirm mutual fit

2. Paid Trial: a paid trial of 3 creative batches so we can see how you think, write and deliver. If your portfolio is strong, we're open to starting right away



KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date, so expectations are crystal clear from day one.





COMPENSATION



USD $3,000 - $5,000 per month base contract rate (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.



We spend $100,000 to $300,000 per month on Meta.

title: SEO Account Manager (SEO Strategy & On-Page)
description:
Own SEO strategy, research and on-page for a book of US clients, starting from who the customer is, not from a keyword list. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



Our SEO team has four specialists (technical, local, off-page and this seat) under a department lead. This seat owns the thinking: buyer research, competitive benchmarking, keyword and intent strategy, on-page direction, the monthly content plan, and the strategy each client works from. This is not a client-relations role. You will work on the SEO account itself, and our Client Relations team owns the client conversation. 



On our larger clients we run an automated agent that proposes on-page fixes. You approve every change individually, because a fix is only right in the context of the strategy behind it. Client content is drafted by an AI writing engine we built and refined by our Copywriter; you hold the final review before it is published. 



What you will do 



-Research each client's buyers and competitors, and turn that into keyword, intent and topic plans. 

-Approve or reject automated on-page changes one at a time, and hand-build schema on the pages that matter most. 

-Brief the month's content, then review and publish it. 

-Run quarterly site audits and d
 what gets fixed first. 

-D
 what goes to our technical specialist and what goes to our web team, then check it was done. 

-Prepare the inputs for monthly client reports and check the reports before they go out. 



What we are looking for 



-3+ years of hands-on SEO strategy, ideally at an agency with several clients at once. 

-Real research skill: you can read reviews, forums and search data and find the pattern in them. 

-Google Search Console and GA4 at analysis depth. 

-You can write and validate JSON-LD schema by hand. 

-You can write a brief a writer can use, and send back a draft that is not good enough. 

-You would rather tell a client the realistic answer than the encouraging one. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas or a similar SEO platform. Rank Math. Microsoft Clarity. Bing Webmaster Tools. Local SEO. A considered view of where AI-generated content and reports can be trusted. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. Tell us about a high-volume keyword you deliberately did not target. Why? 



2. An automated tool proposes an on-page change that is technically correct but you think is wrong for this client. What do you do? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.

Can you create an ad that makes someone stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds — and gives them a reason to buy?



If your answer is yes, keep reading.



We’re not looking for another video editor.



We’re looking for someone who can take an idea, turn it into a complete ad using AI, and create content that actually drives sales.



Because a polished video means nothing if nobody watches it.



Great ads start with great hooks, strong messaging, and a clear understanding of what makes people stop, pay attention, and take action.



If you understand that, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.



## What You’ll Do



You’ll create high-converting ads from start to finish using AI.



Your work will include:



* Creating AI avatars

* Producing AI voiceovers

* Creating UGC-style content from scratch

* Editing raw footage when needed

* Developing new hooks, angles, and creative concepts

* Turning ideas into ads designed to generate sales



You won’t just be editing footage.



You’ll be responsible for turning an idea into creative that gets attention and drives action.



## You’re a Great Fit If...



* You don’t just edit — you create

* You’ve already built ads using AI tools

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You know how to create strong hooks and compelling messaging

* You think about conversions, not just aesthetics

* You think like a marketer, not just an editor

* You bring ideas instead of waiting to be told what to do



## AI Experience Is Required

* ElevenLabs

* Kie ai

* Higgsfield

* Veo

* Nano Banana



If these tools are completely new to you, this probably isn’t the right role.

title: Wedding Photo Editor | Lightroom Classic | Freelance
description:
Hiring: Freelance Wedding Photo Editor | Lightroom Classic | Project Based



Hi there!



I'm a wedding photographer based in Canada, and I'm looking for a talented and reliable freelance photo editor to help me with my wedding galleries.



I'm specifically looking for someone who can work on a project basis, handle multiple wedding editing projects at a time and consistently meet deadlines without compromising on quality.



I currently have a wedding gallery of around 2,000 photos that needs editing, so I'm hoping to find someone who can start soon!



I've already edited the highlight photos myself, so I'm looking for someone who can use my existing edits as a reference and continue editing the remaining photos in the same style.



I'm hoping to find someone I can build a long term working relationship with for future projects too!



Tasks you'll be helping me with:



* Editing wedding photos using Adobe Lightroom Classic

* Matching my existing editing style as closely as possible

* Correcting exposure, white balance, contrast and colours

* Maintaining natural, true to tone colours and beautiful skin tones

* Keeping the editing consistent throughout the entire wedding gallery

* Working with my existing Lightroom catalogs and Smart Previews

* Paying attention to different lighting situations, including indoor, outdoor, natural light and flash photography

* Making small adjustments or revisions when needed

* Returning the completed Lightroom catalog with all adjustments intact



I'll provide reference photos, my existing edits and guidance on the editing style I'm looking for.



Important: Colour Accurate Monitor Required



Colour accuracy is extremely important to me, especially when it comes to wedding photography and natural skin tones.



**You must have a properly calibrated, colour accurate monitor suitable for professional photo editing.**



Ideally, I'm looking for someone who:



* Uses a colour accurate monitor with at least 99% sRGB coverage

* Has calibrated their monitor using a hardware calibration device such as a Datacolor Spyder or Calibrite

* Understands colour management and consistent colour reproduction

* Can maintain accurate skin tones across different lighting conditions

* Regularly checks and maintains their monitor calibration



Please mention your monitor brand, model and calibration method when applying.



What I am NOT looking for:



* Someone who simply applies a preset to every photo without checking the results

* Someone who completely changes my editing style

* Someone who uses heavy filters, excessive saturation or unnatural skin tones

* Someone who edits on an uncalibrated or unreliable display

* Someone who struggles to manage multiple projects or meet deadlines

* Someone who is disorganized or needs constant reminders

* Someone who has difficulty communicating in English

* Someone who disappears during a project without providing updates

* Someone who relies entirely on AI editing without manually reviewing the photos



What I AM looking for:



Experience is great, but attention to detail, consistency, reliability and meeting deadlines are more important to me.



I'm looking for someone who:



* Has strong experience with Adobe Lightroom Classic

* Understands wedding photography and different lighting conditions

* Can accurately follow and match an existing editing style

* Has a good eye for natural colours, exposure and skin tones

* Uses a properly calibrated, colour accurate editing monitor

* Can comfortably handle multiple wedding galleries at the same time

* Is organized and consistently meets agreed deadlines

* Communicates well in English and provides regular progress updates

* Is open to feedback and willing to make revisions when needed

* Has a reliable computer and fast internet connection

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Takes client privacy and confidentiality seriously



Work Details & Payment



This is a **freelance, project based position**, not a full time or fixed hourly role.



Most wedding galleries will have around 500 to 2,000 photos.



All photos will already be selected and culled. I'll provide my edited highlight photos as references so you can follow the same editing style throughout the gallery.



The work mainly involves Lightroom colour correction, exposure, white balance, cropping and maintaining consistency. Extensive Photoshop retouching is not included.



**Payment per wedding gallery (CAD):**



* 500 to 1,000 photos: $150

* 1,001 to 1,500 photos: $250

* 1,501 to 2,000 photos: $300



**Expected turnaround:** Ideally 7 Days per wedding.



**Work arrangement:** Fully remote, freelance and project based.



I'm looking for someone who has the capacity to take on multiple wedding galleries when needed while maintaining consistent quality and meeting deadlines.



There may be multiple projects available depending on the workload, so I'm hoping to find someone reliable who would be interested in working together long term.



A small paid test edit will be required before starting our first project.



How to Apply:



If this sounds like something you'd enjoy doing, I'd love to hear from you!



Please include the following in your application:



1. A little introduction about yourself and your photo editing experience

2. A link to your wedding photo editing portfolio, preferably with before and after examples

3. Your experience working with Lightroom Classic catalogs and Smart Previews

4. Are you comfortable with the project rates mentioned above?

5. Your usual turnaround time for 1,000 to 2,000 photos

6. How many wedding galleries can you comfortably handle at the same time?

7. What brand and model of monitor do you use for editing?

8. Is your monitor hardware calibrated? If yes, which calibration device do you use?

9. Your internet connection speed and general availability

10. Are you happy to complete a small paid test edit before starting a full project?

11. Share one of your favourite inspirational quotes and tell me why you like it.

12. What do you enjoy most about photo editing, especially wedding photography?



**One small thing!**



Please start your application with the words **"Wedding Stories"** so I know you've read the full job post. :)



I'm really hoping to find someone who genuinely enjoys photo editing, takes pride in their work and pays attention to the little details.



I value good communication, consistency, reliability and someone who can deliver beautiful work on time.



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Thank you so much!

**Compensation:** $10–$15 USD/hour + Performance-Based Incentives  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Long-Term



## About the Position



We are a growing weight-loss and medical wellness business looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Specialist who can develop and manage advertising campaigns across Meta 
 and Instagram), Google, and YouTube.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to create and publish advertisements.



We need someone who understands how to strategically target the right people, minimize wasted advertising spend, generate qualified leads, increase appointment bookings, and ultimately bring in more paying customers and revenue.



**Our primary focus is Meta Ads, with Google Ads and YouTube Ads as additional channels.**



## Responsibilities



- Develop and manage Meta advertising campaigns, including
 and Instagram.

- Research and identify the right audiences and targeting strategies.

- Manage Google Ads, including keyword research, search intent, and negative keywords.

- Develop and manage YouTube advertising campaigns.

- Independently develop advertising strategies and allocate budgets across platforms.

- Set up and manage Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

- Develop ad copy, headlines, and creative concepts; create some advertisements and work with materials provided by the company.

- Implement retargeting strategies to reach people who have previously interacted with our business.

- Continuously test and optimize campaigns to reduce costs and improve lead quality.

- Track leads, booked appointments, new customers, and revenue generated.

- Provide regular performance reports and recommendations.



## What We're Looking For



- Proven hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

- Strong Google Ads and keyword research experience.

- Experience with YouTube Ads.

- Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, and conversion optimization.

- Experience setting up pixels, analytics, and conversion tracking.

- Ability to manage advertising budgets strategically and independently.

- Experience generating qualified leads and actual customers, not just clicks.

- Healthcare, weight-loss, wellness, or aesthetics advertising experience is a plus.



## Compensation



**$10–$15 USD/hour + performance-based incentives.**



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity who can demonstrate results and grow with the business.



## Application Questions



Please answer all questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have with Meta Ads, Google Ads, and YouTube Ads?



2. What is the largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed? Please describe your results.



3. Have you managed campaigns for healthcare, weight-loss, wellness, or appointment-based businesses? Explain briefly.



4. What tracking tools have you personally set up and used? (Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager, etc.)



5. Please describe one successful advertising campaign you personally managed. Include the budget, number of leads, cost per lead, appointments or customers generated, and results. Screenshots or reports are welcome.



6. What is your expected hourly rate?



## Practical Advertising Challenge – Required



Imagine you are managing advertising for a weight-loss clinic with a monthly advertising budget of **$3,000** across Meta, Google, and YouTube.



The business has been receiving clicks and inquiries, but many leads are unqualified, few people book appointments, and advertising money is being wasted.



**Explain briefly how you would approach this situation.**



Please address:



- How would you divide the $3,000 budget between the three platforms, and why?

- How would you target people who are genuinely interested in purchasing the service?

- What keywords and targeting strategies would you use?

- How would you track which campaigns generate actual appointments and paying customers?

- If you generated 50 leads but only 3 booked appointments, what would you investigate and change?



We are looking for specific strategies and practical knowledge, not generic answers such as "I would optimize the campaigns."



## How to Apply



Please submit your application through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



Include your answers to all six questions and the practical advertising challenge.



We are looking for someone who can think strategically, take ownership of advertising campaigns, manage budgets responsibly, and turn advertising spend into measurable business growth.

title: Freelance UX/UI Designer
description:
About the gig

We have a live B2B SaaS application and an existing Figma file, and we're looking for a freelance UX/UI designer to audit, modernize and upgrade the design. You'll work directly with our full-stack developer.



Where things stand



The Figma file holds the original design.

The live product has since moved away from it: our developer changed the navigation menus and other elements directly in code.

We'll provide screenshots of the current product. Our stack is React and Node.js.



What you'll do



Audit and recommend. Review the live app and Figma file, identify usability issues and inconsistencies in navigation, information architecture and workflows, and help us prioritize fixes by impact and effort.

Modernize the interface. Set a cohesive visual direction (layout, spacing, typography, color, hierarchy) and redesign navigation, dashboards, tables, forms, cards and detail views where needed, especially the data-heavy screens.

Improve workflows. Simplify how users create, view, edit and manage records, cover all states (loading, empty, error, success, disabled), and prototype the significant changes.

Build a design system. Create or improve our Figma component library using variables, variants and auto layout, with reusable patterns that are practical to build in React.

Hand off and follow through. Bring the Figma file back to being the source of truth, deliver developer-ready specs, check feasibility with our developer and review the implemented designs.



Required



A portfolio of shipped B2B SaaS or complex web applications, including redesigns of existing products

Advanced Figma skills: components, variants, auto layout, design systems

Strong UX fundamentals and visual design skills

Experience with dashboards, complex forms, data tables and management interfaces

Able to explain design decisions, work within technical constraints and collaborate directly with a developer

Clear communication and openness to feedback



Nice to have



Experience with construction management, project management, ERP or other workflow-heavy SaaS

Familiarity with React and modern component libraries

Understanding of responsive design and WCAG accessibility

Experience with lightweight usability testing

title: Heir Outreach Setter — Remote Phone Role (No Closing, No Commission)
description:
JABO REI · Remote, Philippines



Some people make one call, leave one message, and move on. You are the person who tries the other number, at the better hour, with the sentence that finally gets the right person talking.



JABO REI buys inherited Florida houses with complicated title. Our closers can only help a family once someone actually reaches the person who d
. Dozens of our files are waiting on exactly that: the research is done, the family is mapped, the numbers are known — and nobody has yet had the real conversation. That is this job.



The work



You own a defined pool of stuck files. Every week, each one ends in exactly one of three states:



1. A real, two-way conversation with the decision-maker — the owner, the controlling heir, or the family member everyone else defers to.

2. A closer callback, booked at a specific time, for the conversation that goes beyond your bands.

3. A verified exit — a refusal in their own words, the wrong party confirmed, or every number genuinely exhausted.



Anything else is an attempt, not progress — and attempts are the job too: at least two per file per week, across different numbers and different times of day, by call, voi
, and text. Oldest files first. Every attempt logged the same day: who answered, what they said, and the next step, with a date.



Numbers, honestly



You will talk about price — inside firm bands we give you. Inside the bands, you may present our offer or record the family's ask. Beyond the bands, you never improvise: you book the closer. You do not negotiate terms, promise timelines, or discuss legal outcomes. A refusal ends the conversation with grace, and it counts — a clean exit is worth more than a forced maybe.



Who thrives here



People who have done appointment setting, collections, retention, escalations, intake, care coordination — any phone work where the person was hard to reach, the moment was hard, and stopping early was not an option. You do not need real estate experience, and you do not need to have been a closer. You do need two things at once: the persistence to make the fifth attempt, and the ear to hear, in the first thirty seconds, which sentence is the real door — then walk through it instead of reading past it.



You will speak less than the heir does. Your calls are recorded and graded on listening, on what you uncovered, and on whether the file moved — never on how much you talked.



Terms



- $5 per hour, no commission. This is a setter seat, not a closer seat.

- Start at 4 hours a day, inside the Florida calling window (8 AM–8 PM Eastern — overnight in the Philippines). Hours grow as deals you touched close: 5 a day after the first, 6 after the second.

- Quiet room, reliable internet, good headset. English C1 or higher: fluent, warm, unhurried.



How we hire



1. Application. Answer the one question below, inside your OnlineJobs.ph application.

2. A packet and three timed tests. If your application lands, you receive a personal link: upload your résumé, take the free DISC test at 
 and upload a screenshot of your results. Then three timed tests, each in one sitting: an aptitude test, the Curiosity Test (fragments of real conversations — you choose the next question), and a simulated call exercise graded the way we grade real calls.

3. A video. Three to five minutes, one take: why this role, what you bring, your superpower.

4. An interview and a live roleplay call, graded exactly as real calls are.



Most people finish these tests. Very few max them. We hire from these results more than from résumés.



Application question (required): Tell us about someone who was hard to reach — or hard to get talking — where your persistence and your listening together changed the outcome. What did you try, what did you finally hear, and what did you do with it? Specifics, please.



If you are still thinking about the file everyone else gave up on, this role was built for you.



— JABO REI
