title: Experienced Bookkeeper for Australian Accounting Practice
description:
EXPERIENCED BOOKKEEPER for AUSTRALIAN Accounting Firm



###   Are you ready to show us your Australian bookkeeping superpowers?

###   We’re excited to meet the right person — is it you?



We are offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper with a solid background in the bookkeeping environment and proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Xero. Join our growing team and deliver high-quality results by following clearly documented systems in a supportive and efficient workplace.  

Experience with Australian GST is essential. 

Join a values-driven accounting team with extra Easter leave available, and a two-week Christmas shutdown!



A. THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-driven, client-focused bookkeeper who enjoys making a real difference to small businesses. You will be working in a structured, process-oriented environment, where accuracy, productivity and client service are key.

# Client Service Mantra: ACE — Accurate, Cost-effective, and Efficient

# Work Schedule: Monday to Thursday (8:00 am – 5:30 pm AEST, GMT +10) and four hours on Friday



THE ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU IF YOU:

*   Hold formal training in Accounting or Bookkeeping

*   Have SOLID experience in Australian BAS preparation 

*    Understand Australian GST legislation and nuances

*    Love to work as a team with all team members following consistent processes.

*    Love to deliver high-quality work, on time

*    Have a strong grasp of accounting principles and general ledger

*    Communicate clearly in excellent written and spoken English

*    Embrace productivity tools and cloud-based technology (especially QuickBooks Online)

*    Are proactive, solution-focused, and love following procedures

*    Are organised, self-directed, and an efficient time manager

*    Have a strong sense of professional confidentiality and responsibility

*    Can work well under pressure and in a remote team setting

*    Are complimented on your attention to detail and reliability



B.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



You’ll work as part of a small, collaborative team, and will be responsible for:

• Bookkeeping and transaction processing for small business clients

• Accurate general ledger and GST allocations

• Bank reconciliation and review of outstanding transactions

• Preparation of Business Activity Statements (BAS)

• Preparation of year-end workpapers for our accountants



Required Skills & Attributes:



• A genuine passion for accounting and numbers

• Strong understanding of debits and credits (this will be tested)

• Ability to follow procedures and grasp the "why" behind tasks

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Tech-savviness — advanced computer skills will be tested



C.  EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:

## A reliable computer (i5 processor or higher) with minimum 8GB RAM preferable MORE.

## At least TO screens, preferably THREE — ideally a laptop + 2 extra screens or a dual-monitor setup

##  A stable internet connection and a reliable internet backup

## A dedicated home workspace with ergonomic chair and proper desk, away from household interruptions 

## A dedicated noise-cancelling headset (not shared)

## A camera for meetings

## A full keyboard with number pad and mouse

## The hard disk of your computer MUST be less than 80% full



D CHILDCARE ARRANGEMENTS



For applicants with children under 8 years old, a dedicated adult carer must be present during all working hours.



E. WHO ARE WE?



We are a tech-forward, Australian-based accounting firm that supports small businesses across the country. 



We value:

 #  Clear communication

#  A love of learning

#  Commitment to maintaining established procedures and processes

#  Confidentiality and integrity

#  Strong teamwork, even in a remote environment



We have well-documented procedures available in our online portal.



F. WORK SCHEDULE, HOLIDAYS & BENEFITS



## 40 hours per week – Monday to Thursday GMT +10 8:00 am to 5:30 pm and 4 hours on Friday morning. 

      (6:00 am to 2:30 pm Philippine time 

## Pro-rata Annual Leave (7%) and Personal Leave (3.5%)

## 2-week Christmas Shutdown 

## Easter Thursday leave available; 1 & 2 November leave available

## Paid for all gazetted Brisbane (Australia) Public Holidays

## Paid every second week in PHP directly to your bank account

## 13th Month Pay (pro-rata after 6 months service)



Pay is commensurate with experience and reviewed regularly.



G. HOW TO GET OUR ATTENTION



We only shortlist applicants who follow these instructions exactly. Please include all four items below in your application:



1)  Subject Line



Your application
 must have the exact subject line:  “Bookkeeper Superstar -  <Your Name>”

## This is essential to get past our screening filters.



2)  CIRRICULUM VITAE



Submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae listing all work and study over the past 5 years, plus a summary of prior experience.

### DO NOT send Canva-style 1-page designs. We want substance over style.



3) COVER LETTER



In your letter, tell us:



a)  When and how you discovered your passion for bookkeeping

b)  What a satisfying day at work looks like for you

c)  An example of how tech improved your work/study

d)  How you manage tasks and deadlines

e)  Details of your QuickBooks Online experience

f)  Your understanding of Australian GST — and how you’ve applied it

g)  The best thing you’ve done in Word and Excel — and how it added value

h)  Your favourite subject studied and how you excelled in it

i)   A time you used English professionally with non-Filipino clients/teams

j)  An example of your “can-do” attitude solving a problem

k)  What excites you about working from home

l)  Your expected salary (in PHP) for a 80-hour fortnight



4)  SHORT VIDEO



Make a 30–60 second video using your mobile phone showing your dedicated workspace.

Tell us:

a) How your setup makes you productive

b) How you will keep it confidential from others in your household
salary: AUD $8 to $12 per hour paid fortnightly

Help Build YouTube Channels That People Want to Watch



We’re the team behind Shane Hummus, a career and finance YouTube channel, and we also create content for business owners, YouTube entrepreneurs, and business coaches.

We’re looking for a YouTube Creative Director who understands what makes content perform—from the first three seconds of a video to the thumbnail, title, retention curve, and final call to action.

This is a hands-on creative role. You won’t simply manage a team or review finished videos. You’ll help shape the content from the initial idea through editing, packaging, publishing, and performance analysis.

You’ll work directly with Shane, our clients, and the production team to develop content that earns attention, keeps viewers watching, and helps grow multiple YouTube channels.



If you know how to turn an idea into a strong video—and can explain why that video should perform—we’d love to see your work.

Analyze Performance

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly proactive, energetic, and creative Digital Marketing Specialist who is passionate about all things digital marketing and has a strong eye for sophisticated, premium-quality design.



The ideal candidate is a hands-on, action-oriented individual who can confidently manage and execute a variety of digital marketing activities across multiple client accounts. This role goes beyond simply creating and scheduling social media posts. You will be involved in managing social media platforms, developing content strategies, coordinating digital advertising campaigns, monitoring marketing performance, preparing reports, managing websites, and implementing basic SEO activities.



A strong creative eye is essential. We are particularly interested in someone who understands luxury and premium brand aesthetics, with the ability to create elegant, polished, and visually engaging marketing materials that reflect a high-end brand identity.



We want someone who is switched on, resourceful, and takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions. Someone who keeps up with digital marketing trends, brings fresh ideas to the table, enjoys working across different platforms, and can confidently manage multiple projects and client requirements in a fast-paced environment.



If you are passionate about digital marketing, have a flair for creative design, and enjoy turning ideas into effective marketing campaigns, we'd love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management & Content Marketing



Manage and maintain multiple social media accounts across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Develop and maintain monthly social media content calendars aligned with each client's brand identity, marketing objectives, and target audience.

Create, edit, and publish engaging social media content, including graphics, short-form videos, reels, stories, and other digital assets.

Write compelling captions, marketing copy, and calls to action appropriate for each platform and audience.

Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across all social media channels.

Monitor social media engagement, respond to comments and messages, and help build and maintain online communities.

Stay updated with social media trends, platform updates, and emerging content strategies to identify opportunities for growth and engagement.

2. Creative Design & Brand Aesthetics



Create visually compelling, high-quality marketing materials that reflect each client's brand identity and positioning.

Develop sophisticated, polished, and visually cohesive graphics and digital assets, particularly for premium and luxury brands.

Demonstrate a strong eye for typography, colour palettes, composition, spacing, imagery, and visual storytelling.

Transform photos, videos, and other brand assets into refined and engaging marketing content.

Create visually appealing advertising creatives, promotional materials, and branded digital content.

Ensure all creative outputs maintain a consistent, professional, and premium aesthetic across social media, websites, and digital advertising campaigns.

Bring fresh creative concepts and design ideas while maintaining each client's established brand guidelines.

3. Digital Advertising & Campaign Management



Assist in planning, setting up, managing, and monitoring digital advertising campaigns, particularly across Meta Ads and other relevant platforms.

Develop and coordinate advertising creatives, copy, audience targeting, and campaign requirements.

Monitor advertising performance, track key metrics, and identify opportunities to improve campaign results.

Assist with campaign optimisation, budget monitoring, and performance analysis.

Ensure advertising campaigns align with each client's marketing objectives and target audience.

4. Website Management & SEO



Assist with managing and updating client websites, including uploading content, editing pages, and maintaining website information.

Ensure website content is accurate, engaging, visually appealing, and aligned with each client's brand.

Perform basic SEO activities, including keyword research, on-page optimisation, meta titles and descriptions, headings, and internal linking.

Assist with blog uploads, website content optimisation, and other activities that improve online visibility.

Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvements.

Identify and report technical or content-related website issues when necessary.

5. Reporting & Marketing Coordination



Prepare regular social media, advertising, and digital marketing performance reports.

Track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyse campaign results, and provide actionable insights.

Maintain organised marketing calendars, content schedules, campaign timelines, and project updates.

Coordinate content and campaign approvals with clients.

Manage revisions, follow-ups, and deadlines to ensure marketing activities are delivered on time.

Monitor the progress and performance of marketing activities across multiple client accounts.

Proactively recommend new ideas, strategies, and opportunities to improve each client's digital presence and marketing results.

Requirements



Previous experience in digital marketing, social media management, or a similar marketing role.

Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing principles, and online audience engagement.

Experience creating and managing social media content and marketing calendars.

Understanding of digital advertising, particularly Meta Ads.

Basic knowledge of website management and SEO principles.

Ability to monitor marketing performance, interpret data, and prepare reports.

Strong creative and visual design skills, with an appreciation for luxury, premium, and sophisticated brand aesthetics.

Excellent eye for detail, composition, typography, colour coordination, and visual presentation.

Ability to create elegant, polished, and professionally designed marketing materials rather than relying solely on generic templates.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities.

Highly proactive, energetic, and action-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks.

A creative thinker who can bring fresh ideas, identify opportunities, and recommend improvements.

Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly to changing client requirements.

Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and marketing techniques.

Preferred Skills & Tools



Experience with Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.

Familiarity with Google Ads and Google Analytics 4.

Experience using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar creative tools.

Familiarity with WordPress or other website content management systems.

Knowledge of SEO tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

Experience with social media scheduling and reporting tools.

Familiarity with Metricool and Claude.

Experience working with luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, property, fashion, or other premium brands would be an advantage.

Portfolio Requirements



Applicants are encouraged to provide a portfolio showcasing their creative and digital marketing work, particularly:



Luxury or premium brand social media designs.

Sophisticated promotional graphics and digital advertisements.

Short-form video content, reels, and other social media creatives.

Website designs, landing pages, or website content.

Examples of digital marketing campaigns and their performance, where available.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor & AI Content Creator
description:
E-Commerce Video Editor & AI Content Creator (Full-Time, Remote)



We’re a fast-growing US e-commerce brand, and we’re hiring a skilled video editor who also generates AI content — with one thing to be great at: creating DTC ads that stop the scroll and drive sales.



You already know how to cut high-performing e-commerce video. Here, you’ll pair that craft with the newest AI generation tools to produce ad content that’s faster to make, sharper, and at a scale most brands can’t match. This is where performance creative is heading, and you’ll be right at the front of it.



And you won’t be editing in a vacuum. You’ll join a small, hard-working team that treats content as the engine of the business. We move fast, we test relentlessly, and we obsess over quality. If you’re hungry to get genuinely great at this craft, this is the place to do it.



Compensation: $1,000–$1,600/month base, plus performance bonuses — with total earnings up to $2,500/month for strong performers. Raises as you grow.

Schedule: Full-time, remote.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US



A real growth path. We promote from within. Prove yourself and you can grow into a senior creative role with more ownership and responsibility.

Mentorship from people who do this at a high level. You’ll learn directly from experienced marketers and creators, not figure it out alone.

In-house training courses so you keep sharpening your skills and stay ahead of the field.

A team of dedicated people who take pride in their work and back each other up.

A stable, long-term role with a brand that’s scaling fast.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Edit and assemble high-performing DTC video ads in CapCut — this is your bread and butter.

Produce AI-generated video content daily using tools like Kling, Seedance, Sora, and Veo (and whatever’s newest).

Create AI-generated image assets to support our ad campaigns.

Follow creative briefs and SOPs to deliver consistent, on-brand output.

Stay on top of the latest AI generation tools and techniques, and bring new ideas to the team.

Collaborate with the team and contribute creative direction, not just execution.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



2+ years editing video for e-commerce / DTC brands — this is the core of the role and non-negotiable.

At least 6 months creating AI-generated video and image content.

Hands-on experience with AI tools like Kling, Sora, Seedance, or Nano Banana Pro (or similar / the latest versions).

Strong CapCut editing and post-production skills.

A sharp eye for quality and real attention to detail.

Able to work independently in a remote setting and consistently hit daily output.

Good written and spoken English.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill out our short application form:

Include your portfolio: share your 2–3 best ads you’ve ever made — and tell us what brand they were for. No portfolio means we can’t consider you, so make sure to include your best work.

To prove you actually read this post, start your application message with the word “CINEMATIC”. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



We read every application that follows these three steps. If you’re talented and driven, we’d love to see what you can do.

Engagement: Freelance / Long-Term Collaboration

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience, creative ability and agreed deliverables



About us

We’re a business specialising in rare and collectable luxury watches, serving watch enthusiasts and collectors internationally.

We produce content featuring extraordinary timepieces, watch collecting, craftsmanship, industry insights and the stories behind the watches.

While we take watches seriously, we don't believe watch content needs to be serious all the time.

We appreciate clever humour, engaging storytelling, unexpected creative moments and videos that entertain as much as they inform.

We're looking for an experienced, imaginative video editor who can bring our footage to life—not simply someone who can cut clips together.



The Role

We're seeking a talented video editor who combines technical excellence, creative storytelling, a strong sense of humour and the ability to work independently.

You'll be editing both long-form YouTube videos and short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social media platforms.

You'll work with footage supplied by our team, but we expect you to contribute your own creative judgment, ideas and improvements.

We don't want to have to explain every cut, transition or joke. We want someone who understands the content, recognises creative opportunities and knows how to make a good video even better.



Key Responsibilities

1. Video Editing & Post-Production

• Edit engaging long-form YouTube videos featuring vintage watches, collecting, reviews, discussions and industry insights.

• Create compelling short-form videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and
.

• Select the best footage and structure it into clear, entertaining stories.

• Perform professional colour correction, sound mixing and audio clean-up.

• Incorporate appropriate music, sound effects, subtitles, graphics and transitions.

• Maintain consistent production quality and visual identity across our content.

• Organise project files and deliver completed videos in the required formats.



2. Creative Storytelling & Humour

• Understand the intended message and develop an engaging narrative from the footage.

• Recognise naturally funny moments and enhance them through editing.

• Use pacing, reaction shots, sound effects, cuts and timing to create humour where appropriate.

• Suggest creative improvements that make videos more entertaining and memorable.

• Balance humour with a sophisticated visual style appropriate for a luxury-watch brand.

• Adapt editing styles to suit different formats, audiences and subjects.



3. Independent Problem-Solving & Quality Control

• Take ownership of assigned video projects from initial footage review to final delivery.

• Identify potential issues with footage, audio, pacing or storytelling and proactively suggest solutions.

• Apply feedback and previously established editing preferences to future projects.

• Review your own work carefully before submission.

• Manage agreed deadlines and communicate progress or obstacles promptly.

• Take responsibility for mistakes, identify their cause and correct them without unnecessary excuses or delays.

What We're Looking For



Essential Skills & Experience

• At least 5 years of professional video-editing experience, supported by a strong portfolio.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or comparable professional editing software.

• Demonstrated experience editing both long-form YouTube videos and short-form social media content.

• Excellent understanding of storytelling, pacing, visual composition and audience engagement.

• Strong technical skills in colour correction, audio editing, captions and motion graphics.

• Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to understand creative direction and constructive feedback.



Our Preferred Editing Style

Our content combines luxury, knowledge, personality and entertainment.



We appreciate:

• Cinematic visuals that showcase the craftsmanship and details of exceptional watches.

• Engaging, natural storytelling rather than unnecessary effects.

• Clever humour and excellent comedic timing.

• Creative editing that enhances the personalities of the people on screen.

• Strong openings that capture attention without resorting to misleading clickbait.

• Thoughtful pacing that keeps viewers interested.

Strategy & Finance Function Development

▪   Set the direction for DataTel's finance function and build a practical 12- to 24-month improvement roadmap.

▪   Evaluate bookkeeping, payroll, tax, and other finance activities to determine what should be handled in-house, outsourced, or automated based on cost, quality, risk, and capacity.

▪   Prioritize and execute finance improvement projects with leadership, operations, and DataTel's technical and automation resources.

▪   Monitor improvements after launch, resolve issues, measure results, and keep documentation current.

Accounting, Close & Financial Reporting

▪   Own full-cycle bookkeeping and accounting in accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, or a comparable platform, including the chart of accounts, journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and accurate general ledger coding.

▪   Lead a timely and accurate month-end and year-end close using a documented checklist and supporting schedules.

▪   Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and a leadership-ready reporting package that includes the P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and key performance indicators.

▪   Coordinate with outside bookkeeping partners and the company's CPA on record accuracy, tax planning, preparation, filings, and owner tax distribution estimates.

▪   Maintain clean, diligence-ready books and support the integration of acquired companies' financial information when needed.

▪   Support SBA lender reporting, loan compliance, required financial statements, tax returns, and covenant calculations.

Billing, Accounts Receivable & Collections

▪   Review service tickets, projects, and client agreements for billable work and generate accurate, timely invoices through 



DataTel's PSA and billing systems.

▪   Verify that recurring agreement billing matches contracted services and resolve billing adjustments, credit memos, prorated charges, and invoice corrections.

▪   Own the accounts receivable ledger end to end, including payment application, unapplied cash, aging management, disputes, refunds, chargebacks, and NSF payments.

▪   Run a consistent and professional collections process across current, 31–60 day, and 60+ day balances, escalating issues when needed.

▪   Match customer payments from checks, ACH, and online payment platforms to bank deposits and resolve variances.

▪   Provide accurate and timely revenue data to third-party telecom compliance resources supporting FCC Form 499, USF, and related filings.



Payables, Vendors, Spend & Cost Control

▪   Own accounts payable and spend management, including approval workflows, invoice coding, receipts, and appropriate leadership approval for larger payments and new vendors.

▪   Serve as a primary finance contact for vendors regarding invoices, account questions, and disputes.

▪   Partner with operations on vendor bill reconciliation and contract pricing analysis, including identifying margin gaps, billing errors, and preventable cost leakage.

▪   Review software subscriptions and overhead spending to identify savings and improve cost control.

▪   Maintain appropriate inventory tracking and valuation for voice and network equipment.



Planning, Analysis & Compliance

▪   Lead the annual budget, rolling cash-flow forecast, and budget-versus-actual reporting.

▪   Maintain an accurate calendar of recurring filings and renewals, including business licenses, annual reports, personal property tax returns, state business taxes, and insurance renewals.

▪   Develop and maintain finance Scorecard measures in EOS, such as days to close, DSO, accounts receivable over 60 days, cash position, billing accuracy, and gross margin by service line.

▪   Participate in the appropriate weekly Level 10 meeting and own quarterly Rocks related to the finance function.

▪   Build models and provide analysis that supports pricing, profitability, cash management, and growth decisions.

Systems, Automation, AI & Documentation

▪   Use AI tools as part of daily work to accelerate reconciliations, transaction coding, variance analysis, reporting, collection communications, data cleanup, and documentation.

▪   Design, build, and maintain secure automations and integrations across accounting software, the PSA and billing system, spend-management tools, CRM, payment platforms, and banking workflows.

▪   Evaluate AI, fintech, and automation tools with a security-first mindset, including data handling, access permissions, system ownership, and vendor terms.

▪   Write and maintain clear SOPs so every finance process is documented, repeatable, auditable, and not dependent on one person.

▪   Partner with technical resources when APIs, Power Automate, Zapier, Make, Power Query, Python, or Model Context Protocol integrations can remove manual work.

▪   Protect confidential financial, payroll, client, and employee information and follow DataTel's security and access-control requirements.



How Our Core Values Show Up in This Role

▪   Help First: You are a resource to the whole company. When a team needs a margin check, billing fix, report, or answer to a client invoice question, you help get it solved.

▪   Do What You Say You’re Going to Do: The close happens when promised, reports arrive on time, and potential delays are communicated early and clearly.

▪   Be the Solution: You do not stop at identifying a problem. You recommend and implement a fix, then address the root cause so the issue does not repeat.

▪   Work Smart: When work is repetitive, you look for a secure, sustainable way to automate it, simplify it, or eliminate it.

What We're Looking For

▪   An accounting or finance degree. Contador Público or an equivalent qualification is appropriate for Argentina-based candidates.

▪   At least 6 years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close for a US-based company.

▪   Strong understanding of US GAAP, accrual accounting, reconciliations, financial statements, and revenue recognition for recurring services.

▪   Advanced proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, or similar platforms, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and financial modeling.

▪   Hands-on experience with billing, accounts receivable, collections, accounts payable, payroll, and general accounting.

▪   Demonstrated use of AI to improve accounting or reporting work. Candidates should be prepared to explain what they built, the tools used, and the result.

▪   Excellent written and spoken English and confidence communicating with clients, vendors, outside accountants, and company leadership.

▪   High attention to detail, sound judgment with financial data, strong responsiveness, and the discipline to work independently in a remote environment.



Strongly Preferred

▪   Experience moving accounting work from an outsourced provider in-house or building a finance function from the ground up.

▪   Experience with ConnectWise PSA or another PSA/billing platform in an MSP, IT services, telecom, cybersecurity, or recurring-services environment.

▪   Experience with US payroll platforms such as Gusto and spend-management tools such as Ramp.

▪   Experience building automations or system integrations using APIs, Power Automate, Zapier, Make, Power Query, Python, or MCP servers.

▪   Familiarity with payment platforms, bank feeds, automated cash application, multi-state payroll, telecom reporting support, or SBA lender reporting.

▪   CPA, progress toward a CPA, CFA or another relevant professional accounting certification.



The Mindset We Want

▪   Owner: You take responsibility for the accuracy, timeliness, and usefulness of the finance function.

▪   Builder: You create systems and documentation that make the company stronger and less dependent on tribal knowledge.

▪   AI-Forward: You routinely ask how work can be automated or improved without compromising security or accuracy.

▪   Responsive: You communicate clearly, keep others informed, and do not allow questions or problems to sit unresolved.

▪   Trustworthy: You handle financial, payroll, employee, and client information with care and respect appropriate controls.



Compensation: USD 15–16 per hour for candidates based in the Philippines.

▪   Paid time off, sick leave, and US holiday off

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
We are a US-based social media marketing agency creating short-form video content for businesses.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive Social Media Assistant to help us stay organized, monitor client performance, and research creative content ideas.



This is a flexible, part-time role with a small daily workload and occasional additional tasks.



We're not looking for someone to work eight hours a day. We simply want someone dependable who checks in daily, takes initiative, and makes sure important things don't get missed.



 Your Responsibilities



1. Daily Social Media Monitoring

- Briefly review our clients' social media performance each day 

- Identify posts that are performing particularly well compared to their usual results.

- Share positive performance updates in the appropriate client WhatsApp group chats.

- Flag anything unusual or worth our attention.



2. Follow-Ups & Reminders

- Track important follow-ups, deadlines, and pending tasks.

- Remind our team when something needs attention.

- Help ensure nothing gets forgotten or overlooked.

- Provide a quick daily update when necessary.



3. Viral Video Research (Occasional)

- Before upcoming client video shoots, research successful social media accounts in the client's industry.

- Find viral Reels, TikToks, and Shorts that could inspire content ideas.

- Share video links and briefly explain why the content works.

- Organize the strongest ideas for our team to review before the shoot.



4. Video Thumbnail Selection (Occasional)

- Review videos already scheduled in our social media scheduling software.

- Select the best-looking frame as the video thumbnail or cover.

- Focus on making each client's social media profile look professional and visually appealing.



All videos will already be edited and scheduled. You will not be responsible for video editing or scheduling content.



Requirements

- Good knowledge of Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to recognize viral content and strong-performing posts.

- Good written English.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Drive, and social media tools.

- Dependable, responsive, and proactive.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Experience with Metricool and WhatsApp client communication is a plus.



Schedule

- Brief daily check-in for performance monitoring and reminders.

- Additional research assignments before upcoming video shoots.

- Occasional thumbnail selection.

- Very flexible working hours.

- Workload may vary throughout the week.



We care about reliability and results, not how many hours you spend online.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience working with social media.

4. Your general daily availability.

5. How you would go about finding viral videos for a client in their industry



Start your application with "Assistant for EZ" so we know you've read the job description.



We're looking for someone reliable, resourceful, and interested in a long-term working relationship.

title: AI Operations & Content Coordinator
description:
Company:PhenomenalM  

Location:Remote  

Reports to: Chief Alignment Officer



PhenomenalM is a fast-growing digital education and technology company on a mission to help 100,000 people consciously create extraordinary lives. See brand on Instagram here: 



We're building innovative digital experiences, membership programs, and a growing content ecosystem.



We're a small, ambitious team that moves quickly, embraces AI and technology, and values people who take ownership, think independently, and make things happen.



About the Role



We're looking for an exceptionally resourceful **AI Operations & Content Coordinator** who loves organizing moving pieces, solving problems, using technology, and getting things DONE.



This is a hybrid role combining content operations, project coordination, data tracking, and general business operations.



You'll work closely with company leadership to keep our content, campaigns, programs, and internal projects organized and moving forward.



We're not looking for someone who needs detailed instructions for every task. We want someone who can take an outcome, figure out the best way to accomplish it, and execute efficiently.



You'll thrive here if you love AI, move quickly, take initiative, and genuinely enjoy turning chaos into organized systems.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Calendar & Publishing Coordination 



Own and maintain one master content calendar connecting our public marketing channels and private member programs.



- Coordinate Instagram Reels, posts, Stories, and promotional campaigns.

- Manage content calendars for our digital programs, memberships, and communities.

- Coordinate live sessions, content releases, program activations, and
 campaigns.

- Ensure content across Instagram and our programs is aligned with current campaigns and company priorities.

- Organize approved content, captions, creative assets, links, and publishing dates.

- Coordinate with content creators, editors, and other team members to ensure assets are ready on time.

- Schedule and publish approved content as assigned.

- Proactively identify gaps, conflicting schedules, missing assets, or upcoming deadlines.



 2. Content Performance & Feedback Loop



Help us understand what's working, what's not, and what we should do more of.



- Track content performance across Instagram, campaigns, and member programs.

- Build and maintain simple, accurate dashboards using Google Sheets, ChatGPT, Claude, and other reporting tools.

- Monitor meaningful metrics such as engagement rates, link clicks, conversions, purchases, and member participation.

- Collect audience feedback, recurring questions, comments, testimonials, and content insights.

- Identify patterns in high-performing and low-performing content.

- Share weekly performance summaries with the team.

- Recommend opportunities to repeat, improve, or test content based on actual data.

- Ensure insights and feedback are communicated to the right team members and reflected in future content planning.



Our goal isn't just to publish more content. It's to continuously learn what works and improve our results.



3. Project Management & Team Coordination



Keep multiple projects organized and moving forward.



- Maintain our project management system with clear tasks, owners, priorities, and deadlines.

- Coordinate projects across marketing, content, technology, and member experience.

- Follow up with team members and ensure commitments are completed.

- Schedule meetings, project milestones, and important deliverables.

- Identify potential delays or missing information before they become problems.

- Turn leadership requests into organized action plans.

- Provide concise project status updates and flag decisions that need leadership attention.



4. AI, Data & Systems



Use AI and technology to help our team work smarter and faster.



- Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to research, organize information, analyze data, and accelerate execution.

- Create and maintain Google Sheets trackers, reports, and dashboards.

- Identify repetitive manual tasks that could be simplified or automated.

- Build simple workflows using existing tools or no-code automation platforms.

- Organize information so the team can easily find what they need.

- Document repeatable processes and improve how work gets done.

- Verify AI-generated information and ensure reports are accurate.



5. General Business Operations



Be a versatile execution partner for day-to-day business needs.



Examples include:



- Coordinating Google Workspace accounts and onboarding for new employees.

- Organizing shared drives, documents, and team resources.

- Researching software, vendors, and potential solutions.

- Troubleshooting basic operational and technical issues.

- Scheduling meetings and coordinating calendars.

- Handling quick-turn requests and miscellaneous operational projects.

- Supporting leadership with tasks that need to get done efficiently.



No two days will look exactly alike. We need someone who enjoys variety and adapts quickly.



Must-Haves



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- 3+ years Experience coordinating IG content calendars, social media publishing, or digital campaigns.

- 2+ years Strong Google Workspace skills, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Calendar.

- 2+ years Experience in online education, digital products, coaching businesses, memberships, or creator-led companies.

- Ability to organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Excellent in working with AI data, spreadsheets, and performance reports.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

- Excellent follow-through and communication.

- Ability to research, troubleshoot, and learn unfamiliar tools independently.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.



Bonus Experience



- Experience with Looker Studio or dashboard creation.

- Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, or other automation platforms.

- Experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or Notion.

- Familiarity with Kajabi, ManyChat, or
 marketing platforms.

- Experience coordinating content across multiple programs or communities.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



You're resourceful. When you encounter something unfamiliar, your first instinct is to research, experiment, and figure it out.



You're fast. You understand the importance of momentum and can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.



You're proactive. You don't just wait for someone to ask for a status update. You anticipate what needs attention.



You're organized. You can manage lots of moving pieces and keep everything visible and on track.



You're analytical. You enjoy looking at data, identifying patterns, and asking how we can improve.



You're AI-forward. You're excited by new technology and constantly finding ways to use it more effectively.



You take ownership. When you're responsible for something, you follow it through to completion.



You're flexible. You're comfortable switching between content coordination, dashboards, projects, and operational requests.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 30 days:



- One organized master content calendar is actively maintained across Instagram, programs, and campaigns.

- Content is consistently scheduled, published, and tracked.

- Content performance dashboards are accurate and updated regularly.

- A weekly feedback loop helps the team understand what's working and what to improve.

- Key projects have clear owners, deadlines, and visible progress.

- Team onboarding and everyday operational requests are handled efficiently.

- Leadership spends significantly less time following up, organizing information, and managing repetitive tasks.

- You've identified and implemented improvements that save the team time.



## Working Expectations



- Full-time, 30-40 hours per week.

- Remote position.

- Consistent availability during agreed working hours, including scheduled overlap with company leadership.

- Comfortable communicating through Google Workspace and our project management tools.

- Able to respond promptly to time-sensitive requests as needed, this is a 24/7 business 

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume and relevant experience.

2. An example of your work. A dashboard, content calendar, or project management system you've created (please remove any confidential information).

3. A brief example of how you've used AI to solve a business problem or save time.

4. (Optional) 2-3 minute video of why you would be amazing for this role. We like bold, audacious team members showcase this side of you.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: SEO & AEO Specialist (AI Search)
description:
Dear Applicants,



SEO & AEO Specialist (AI Search) – We're Hiring! 



Search is changing fast. Shoppers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok as often as they Google, and we want our e-commerce brands to show up in both. You will own our visibility on search engines and AI answer engines, using AI-powered tools to find what is holding us back, fix it, and prove the results with data.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality content with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

• Grow organic traffic and rankings for our brand websites on Google through on-page, technical and content SEO

• Optimise our sites for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Grok): answer-first content, FAQ and schema markup, llms.txt and AI crawler access

• Use Ryze AI to audit our sites, review and apply SEO and AEO fixes, and track rankings and AI citations

title: Freelance Manuscript Reviewer, Amazon KDP Formatter, and Book Cover Designer
description:
We are seeking an experienced publishing professional to review manuscripts, prepare book interiors for Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP), and design covers for eBook, paperback, and hardcover editions.



The ideal candidate combines strong editing skills with professional interior formatting and cover design experience. They should be able to turn a completed manuscript into polished files ready for upload and proof review.

Responsibilities

Manuscript Review



Review manuscripts for grammar, punctuation, spelling, clarity, and consistency. Identify repetitive information, awkward sentences, overlapping sections, and weak chapter transitions. Improve readability while preserving the author’s voice, intended meaning, and preferred reading level.



Provide an edited manuscript with tracked changes and a clean final version. Flag unclear statements and information that may require factual verification. Discuss substantial revisions with the author before changing the content or structure.



Interior Formatting



Format manuscripts for Kindle eBooks and printed paperback and hardcover editions. Prepare consistent chapter headings, paragraph styles, typography, page numbering, headers, front matter, and back matter.



Set appropriate trim sizes, margins, gutters, spacing, and page breaks. Format tables, images, captions, and references where applicable. Create a linked eBook table of contents and accurate print tables of contents.



Check the finished files using the relevant preview tools and correct formatting issues before final delivery.



Book Cover Design



Design original, coordinated covers for all three editions:

- eBook: Front cover.

- Paperback: Full wraparound cover with front, spine, and back.

- Hardcover: Full wraparound cover prepared for the selected KDP hardcover specifications.

Present initial concepts for approval and complete revisions within the agreed scope. Ensure titles remain readable at thumbnail size and the design suits the book’s genre and audience.



Finalize print covers using the approved page count and production settings. Use images, fonts, and design elements licensed for commercial publishing.

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience reviewing and editing manuscripts.

- Experience formatting books for Amazon KDP.

- A portfolio of eBook, paperback, and hardcover covers.

- Proficiency with professional editing, layout, and design software.

- Strong attention to detail and reliable communication.

- Ability to manage revisions and meet agreed deadlines.

Required Deliverables

- Reviewed manuscript with tracked changes.

- Clean, final manuscript in Word.

- Upload-ready eBook interior and cover.

- Separate print-ready paperback and hardcover interior PDFs.

- Separate print-ready paperback and hardcover cover PDFs.

- Editable interior and cover source files.

- Relevant image and font licensing documentation.

Application Requirements

Please submit relevant work samples, an overview of your process, your estimated turnaround time, and an itemized quote. State how many cover concepts and revision rounds are included, whether you work independently or with a team, and any additional fees.



Include your policy for correcting file-related issues identified during KDP upload or print-proof review.

title: Finance Manager – Working Capital & AR
description:
We're an established Australian wholesale and distribution business based in Melbourne. We're growing steadily and looking for a sharp, reliable finance professional to take ownership of our accounts receivable, cash flow, and working capital.



This isn't a bookkeeping role. We already have the transactional side covered. We need someone who can think about cash. Where it's tied up, how to release it faster, and how to make our finance operations run cleanly.



The role: 



You'll own the cash side of our business. Specifically:



Accounts receivable & collections





Manage the debtor ledger end-to-end in Xero

Proactively follow up outstanding invoices via email and phone

Build and maintain strong working relationships with our customers' AP teams

Escalate genuinely problematic debtors with a clear recommendation

Report weekly on aged receivables, DSO, and collection performance





Cash flow management





Maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast

Flag issues early. Don't wait for problems to become crises

Track variances between forecast and actual and explain the drivers





Working capital & trade finance:





Manage our debtor finance / invoice finance facility (drawdowns, reconciliations, reporting to the financier)

Support trade finance arrangements with suppliers

Identify opportunities to reduce our cash conversion cycle - inventory, payables, receivables





Systems & process improvement:





Improve how Xero integrates with our other systems (inventory, CRM, payment platforms)

Automate manual reconciliation and reporting where sensible

Document processes as you build them



About you



Must-haves





5+ years' experience in AR, credit control, or finance operations for businesses billing in AUD, USD, or GBP

Strong hands-on Xero experience (please tell us specifically what you've done in Xero)

Excellent written and spoken English, you'll be emailing and phoning Australian customers directly

Comfortable, professional, and firm when chasing overdue payments

Solid Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivots, basic modelling, not just data entry)

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for customer calls





Nice to have





Accounting degree or CPA (Philippines)

Experience with invoice finance / debtor finance facilities (e.g. Octet, Waddle, Marketlend, Timelio, or similar)

Wholesale, distribution, or importing industry background

Experience integrating Xero with inventory or CRM platforms (Cin7, Unleashed, Dear, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)

Prior experience working directly with Australian businesses





What we offer



13th month pay in December

Paid Philippine public holidays

Clear pathway to full-time within 6–12 months, with a salary increase at that point

Genuine ownership of a function. You're not one of ten people doing the same thing

Direct access to the owner. Decisions get made quickly

Long-term role. We're building a team, not filling a short-term gap





How to apply



Please send:





A short cover note (5–10 sentences) telling us why this role suits you specifically. Generic applications will be skipped

Your CV



A 3–5 sentence answer to this question:

Our 13-week cash flow forecast shows a $80,000 shortfall in week 6. What are the first three things you'd look at, and what levers would you consider pulling?"





We'll invite strong applicants to a paid trial task, followed by a video interview with the General Manager. 



Thank you, we read every application.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist - Dayshift Long term
description:
Role: DIGITAL MARKETING COORDINATOR



ABOUT THE BUSINESS:



We are a fast-growing digital marketing business helping global personalities, experts, and professionals grow their businesses through strategic content promotion, lead generation, and paid advertising.



Our goal is simple: Get the right content in front of the right audience and turn attention into qualified leads and sales.**



We work with a specialist team of media buyers, graphic designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and marketing professionals to deliver high-performing campaigns for our clients.



ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Coordinator to take ownership of coordinating client marketing campaigns from planning through to launch.



You will work closely with clients and our internal delivery team to ensure campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, high quality, and ready to perform.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Campaign Management



* Plan and coordinate multiple marketing and lead generation campaigns from concept through to launch.

* Manage timelines, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies.

* Coordinate clients, media buyers, designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and other specialists.

* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be delivered and when.



Campaign Strategy & Quality Control



* Identify the #1 pain point the campaign is solving and ensure it is relevant to the target audience.

* Ensure consistent messaging across the entire customer journey, including **ads, creative, landing pages, lead magnets, funnels,
s, and calls to action**.

* Review campaign assets and identify gaps, errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure campaigns are as strong as possible before going live.



Content & Optimisation



* Review, rewrite, and optimise ad copy, landing page copy, funnel copy,
 copy, headlines, and calls to action** when required.

* Ensure messaging is clear, compelling, consistent, and aligned with the campaign objective.



Problem Solving & Launch



* Identify roadblocks, missing information, risks, and issues early.

* Proactively solve problems and escalate issues when necessary.

* Conduct final campaign checks before launch.

* Organise and document all campaign assets and information.

* Provide a clear handover to the Media Buyer for post-launch management and optimisation.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



You will use:



*GHL— CRM

*Zoom — Meetings & client communication

*Loom— Screen recordings

*Slack— Team communication

*ClickUp— Project management

*Gmail —

*Google Drive— File management

*Google Sheets — Tracking & reporting



Experience with these tools is an advantage, but we can provide training.



REQUIREMENTS



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Has 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, project management, lead generation, or a similar role.

* Understands paid digital advertising and lead generation.

* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Can confidently communicate with clients and internal team members.

* Has strong problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership abilities.

* Is proactive and takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Has excellent attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

* Enjoys working with creative, marketing, and technical specialists.

* Is eager to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibility.



The Type of person we're looking for:



We are looking for someone who:



*Thinks ahead.

*Takes ownership.

*Spots problems early.

*Solves problems proactively.

*Communicates clearly.

*Pays attention to detail.

*Works well with others.

*Wants to learn and improve.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We will train you on our systems and processes.

What we do need is someone with the attitude, initiative, and work ethic to become exceptional at the role.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful when:



* Campaigns launch on time with minimal delays or last-minute issues.

* Projects are organised and everyone knows what they are responsible for.

* Campaigns are high quality with strong and consistent messaging across every touchpoint.

* Problems are identified early and resolved proactively rather than becoming larger issues.

* Clients are well communicated with and feel confident that their campaigns are being managed professionally.

* Team members have what they need to complete their work efficiently.

* Campaign handovers are complete and organised allowing Media Buyers to take over smoothly.

* You consistently identify opportunities to improve campaigns, messaging, and processes**.

* You require progressively less supervision because you understand what needs to be done and take initiative.

* Ultimately, the campaigns you coordinate contribute to quality leads, sales, and measurable growth for our clients.**



The ultimate measure of success:



*Clients are happy.

*Campaigns launch on time.

*The work is high quality.

*The team is organised.

*Problems are solved before they become problems.

*Our campaigns generate results.**







HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your **CV/resume and cover letter** explaining:



1. Your relevant digital marketing experience.

2. Your experience coordinating or managing marketing campaigns.

3. Your experience with paid advertising and/or lead generation.

4. Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

, Instagram, and Google, with the ultimate goal of turning cold and warm traffic into leads, subscribers, community members, customers, and sales.



This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday during Australian business hours. It is not suitable for candidates looking for part-time, freelance, or gig work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



As our Media Buyer, you will take ownership of the performance of paid advertising campaigns across multiple accounts.



You will work closely with our creative, content, development, and marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly set up, tracked, tested, and continuously improved.



You will not be responsible for writing ad copy, designing graphics, or editing videos.



Instead, your focus will be on understanding what converts, testing different creative and audience combinations, analysing performance, and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Management & Optimisation



Manage and 
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.



Manage Google Ads campaigns where required.



Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.



Continuously test different videos, images, messaging, audiences, offers, placements, and campaign structures.



Analyse campaign data and make informed optimisation decisions.



Scale campaigns that are performing well while identifying and addressing underperforming campaigns.



Optimise campaigns to improve conversion rates and overall return on advertising spend.



Monitor budgets and ensure advertising spend is being allocated effectively.



Identify trends, performance issues, and opportunities before they become major problems.



Testing & Performance



We want someone who genuinely enjoys testing, testing, and testing again.



You will be expected to:



Test different creative assets and variations.



Test different audiences and targeting strategies.



Test different campaign structures and approaches.



Identify winning combinations and scale them.



Quickly recognise what is not working and make changes.



Use campaign data to continuously improve performance.



Develop and communicate clear testing hypotheses.



Tracking & Conversion



Work with developers to establish appropriate tracking for each account.



Assist with setting up general tracking and conversion tracking.



Ensure campaigns are accurately measuring the desired conversion events.



Monitor tracking and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.



Ensure campaign data is reliable enough to support optimisation decisions.



Help ensure the customer journey is properly tracked from advertisement through to conversion.



Funnel & Campaign Congruency



Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.



Identify gaps or inconsistencies that may negatively affect conversion rates.



Work with the broader marketing team to improve the relationship between traffic, landing pages, content, and offers.



Understand the difference between generating traffic and generating qualified conversions.



Lead Generation & Conversion



Depending on the account, campaigns may be designed to convert cold and warm traffic into:



Subscribers



Leads containing name,
, and phone number



 Group members



Customers



Sales



Other defined conversion actions



Your responsibility is to help turn paid traffic into measurable business outcomes, not simply clicks or impressions.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means becoming someone the team can rely on to consistently improve advertising performance through testing, analysis, and optimisation.



In your first 30–60 days, success looks like:



You understand our accounts, campaigns, audiences, funnels, offers, and conversion goals.



Campaigns are properly structured and monitored.



Tracking and conversion events are working correctly.



You can confidently identify campaign performance issues and opportunities.



You are actively testing new creative, audiences, and campaign approaches.



You can clearly explain why you are making specific optimisation decisions.



As you become established in the role, success looks like:



Campaign performance is continuously improving.



You consistently identify and scale winning campaigns and creative.



Poor-performing campaigns are identified and addressed quickly.



You develop a strong understanding of what works for different audiences and offers.



Cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and other relevant KPIs are actively managed.



Advertising budgets are allocated based on performance and opportunity.



Tracking issues are identified and resolved quickly.



You contribute meaningful insights and recommendations to the wider marketing team.



Ultimately, success means:



You can take responsibility for paid traffic performance and demonstrate that your work is generating measurable results for our clients and the business.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply manage ads — we want someone who thinks like a performance marketer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential



2+ years of proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.



Strong experience with
 Ads and Instagram Ads.



Experience with Google Ads.



Demonstrated experience managing and optimising campaigns based on performance data.



Strong understanding of paid advertising and lead generation.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

We especially value people who:

Think in terms of data, outcomes, and ROI.



Don't become emotionally attached to campaigns or creative that isn't working.

Can identify problems and propose solutions.



Are comfortable managing multiple campaigns/accounts.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

 or Google Ads.

title: Sales & Operations Coordinator (Inbound Sales, Dispatch, B2B Appointment Setting) | Australian Home Services | Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US

We're an Australian home services group. Homeowners book our licensed technicians for air conditioning, electrical, plumbing, locksmith and glass work, and we also deliver trade services under contract for large organisations. We have a national network of subcontractor technicians and a small team across Australia and the Philippines.



We've automated most of our front line. An AI voice agent answers calls, takes bookings and payment, and jobs flow into our scheduling system. This role is the person behind that system. You handle what it can't, and you spend the rest of your week helping us grow.



THE ROLE, IN ORDER OF PRIORITY



1. Inbound sales and customer service

- Take the calls our AI agent hands over, close the booking and take payment by secure link

- Handle reschedules, complaints and job questions by phone, SMS and



2. Dispatch and technician coordination

- Watch the job board every day and make sure every job has the right technician

- Fix the exceptions: cancellations, no-shows, late arrivals, failed payments

- Get quotes from technicians, send them to customers and follow up until there's an answer

- Call customers after jobs for feedback and reviews



3. Outbound outreach and appointment setting

- Work target lists of Australian businesses (property managers, facilities and maintenance companies, insurers, disability and aged care providers) by LinkedIn,
 and phone, and book meetings for our General Manager

- Work lists of tradespeople and book intro calls for our Operations Manager

- Keep the pipeline clean in the CRM and report your numbers every week

You book the meeting. You don't have to close the deal.



HOW THE ROLE CHANGES

We're in peak season and the automation is still bedding in. Expect your first six weeks to be mostly phones and dispatch. As the system takes more of the front line, outreach grows to around half your week.



YOU NEED

- 2+ years of outbound B2B appointment setting or SDR work, with numbers you can show. Australian clients are a big plus.

- Phone-based inbound sales or customer service experience, comfortable closing and taking payment

- Experience coordinating or scheduling field staff, contractors or appointments

- Excellent spoken and written English. You'll talk to Australian homeowners, tradespeople and business managers every day.

- Daily CRM experience (GoHighLevel, Salesforce or HubSpot)

- Organised, direct, and willing to tell us when something isn't working. We don't want a yes-person.

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet with a backup, good headset



NICE TO HAVE

- Workflow automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel workflows)

- Digital marketing experience (social media, Canva, Google Business Profile, website content)

- Field service software (ServiceM8 or similar)

- Trades, property, facilities or insurance industry experience



HOURS AND PAY

- Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time (5:00am to 3:00pm Manila time during Australian daylight saving), with a one-hour unpaid break

- PHP 60,000 to 80,000 per month depending on experience, plus a bonus for meetings booked

- Long-term role, start as soon as possible



TO APPLY (VIDEO APPLICATIONS ONLY)

Record a video of up to 5 minutes, camera on, introducing yourself and answering questions 1 to 5 below in order. Upload it to Loom, Google Drive or YouTube (unlisted) and paste the link in your application. Make sure anyone with the link can view it.



Start your written application with the word SUMMER, then add your video link and your written answer to question 6. Applications without a video will not be considered.



ANSWER ON VIDEO

1. Describe your last role booking B2B meetings. Who did you target, which channels did you use, and how many meetings did you book per month?

2. Describe the last role where you closed sales by phone and took payment. What was the process?

3. A customer is booked for 8am tomorrow. At 5pm today the technician cancels and no other technician is confirmed for that area. What do you do, in order?

4. Which CRMs and automation tools have you used hands-on, and what did you build or run in them?

5. Confirm you can work 8:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time, Monday to Friday, and tell us your earliest start date, expected monthly salary, internet speed and backup plan for outages.



ANSWER IN WRITING

6. Write the first LinkedIn message (under 60 words) you would send to the operations manager of a property management company to get a 15-minute call about trade maintenance services.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller (US Wholesaling) | Part Time, Path to Full Time | $4-5/hr
description:
We're Real Venture, a US real estate company that buys houses directly from homeowners (wholesaling). We're hiring one cold caller to talk to motivated sellers and find people who want to sell their house.



This starts part time (20 hours a week, about 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday) and moves to full time after a few weeks for the right person.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call homeowners from lists we provide (pre-foreclosure, probate, tired landlords and similar)

- Find out if they want to sell, their timeline, the condition of the house and their asking price

- Book interested sellers for a call with our team

- Log every call and note in GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers



You do not need to negotiate or make offers. We handle that.



SCHEDULE

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US daytime hours (exact block confirmed when you're hired, likely US Eastern or Central time)

- Full time (40 hours) after a few weeks if it's a good fit



PAY

- $4 to $5 per hour depending on experience

- Paid on time, every time

- Raises based on results



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 6 months of cold calling experience. US real estate cold calling (wholesaling, acquisitions) strongly preferred

- Clear, confident English with a light or neutral accent

- Comfortable with rejection and keeping conversations going

- Reliable internet (at least 10 Mbps) and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Noise-canceling headset and a quiet place to work

- Experience with GHL or a dialer (BatchDialer, CallTools, Mojo, Readymode) is a plus



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip a step will not be read)

1. Start your message with the words: READY TO DIAL

2. Attach a 1 to 2 minute voice recording where you pretend to call a homeowner and ask: "Hi, is this John? I'm calling about your house on Main Street. Would you ever consider selling it if the price was right?" Then keep the conversation going like a real call

3. Tell us how long you've cold called and what you've called for (real estate, solar, insurance, etc.)

4. List any dialers or CRMs you've used

5. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)



We reply to every applicant who follows the steps. Shortlisted applicants do a short live role-play call.

title: AutoCAD 2D Joinery Shop Drawings Drafter (Australian residential cabinetry)
description:
About us



Plot Joinery makes and installs architectural joinery for architect-designed houses in Melbourne, Australia: kitchens, vanities, wardrobes, wall panelling and built-in furniture. Every piece gets a set of 2D shop drawings that the builder and architect approve before we build it.

 and 



The job



Full time, 40 hours a week, starting no later than 7am Philippine time. You will draw joinery shop drawings in AutoCAD 2D from the architect's drawings and schedules, working to our template, drafting standard and checklist, and take them through revisions until they are approved. You will report to our design coordinator.



You must have



- At least 3 years drawing joinery, cabinetry or millwork shop drawings in AutoCAD 2D. Architectural, civil or structural drafting alone is not enough, and neither are 3D renders or SketchUp views.

- Good English.

- Reliable internet and electricity.



Nice to have



- Experience with Australian, New Zealand or UK joinery companies.

- Blum hardware (Legrabox, Movento).

- Microvellum or Cabinet Vision.



How we hire



1. You apply as below.

2. We do a short video call with the shortlist.

3. Shortlisted applicants do a paid test for a fixed one-off fee: one real joinery unit, drawn from our template and brief.

4. The best test gets the job.



HOW TO APPLY (we will not reply to applications that skip these steps)



1. Start your subject line with PLOT-J21, then your name.

2. Attach 2 or 3 PDF shop drawing sheets of joinery you drew yourself in AutoCAD 2D, with a title block, dimensions and at least one section. Blank out client names if you need to.

3. Attach a screenshot of AutoCAD with one of your own shop drawings open, showing the layout tabs and the layer list.

4. Answer these 5 questions. Short answers are fine.

   1. A base cabinet has a 720 mm carcass on a 140 mm kicker (toe kick), with a 20 mm stone benchtop. What is the finished bench height?

   2. What checks do you run on a shop drawing before you send it?

5. Tell us your hourly rate in PHP and what time you can start (Philippine time).

6. Optional: a 60-second video telling us why you would suit this job (link to YouTube unlisted, Google Drive or Loom).
