title: Basketball Video Editor – Highlight Videos & Social Media
description:
Vantage College Recruiting is a growing college basketball recruiting service helping high school basketball players get exposure to college coaches.



I am looking for a talented and efficient full-time Video Editor who can create professional basketball highlight videos and short-form recruiting content for our athletes.



This is not a position for someone who only knows basic video editing. You should understand how to create clean, professional sports content and be comfortable working with basketball game footage.



This has the potential to become a long-term position as the company continues to grow.



Responsibilities

Edit basketball highlight videos for high school athletes

Combine clips from multiple games into organized highlight tapes

Review provided basketball clips and identify the strongest plays

Organize highlights so the athlete’s best plays appear early in the video

Add player identification such as arrows, circles, spotlights, or freeze frames when appropriate

Add professional title screens and player information

Improve audio and video quality when necessary

Create shorter highlight videos for X, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms

Export videos in the correct formats and resolutions

Organize completed projects and source footage

Make revisions when necessary

Follow established editing templates and brand guidelines

Complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality



Depending on the project, you may receive either:



Pre-selected basketball clips, or

Longer game footage that needs to be reviewed



The majority of the role will eventually focus on editing selected clips into professional recruiting videos.



Editing Style



Our highlight videos should be:



Clean

Professional

Easy for college coaches to watch

Focused on the basketball rather than excessive effects

Fast-paced without being distracting

Designed to clearly identify the athlete



The goal is not to create flashy entertainment videos. The goal is to make it extremely easy for a college coach to evaluate the player.



Preferred Software



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro

CapCut



You should have access to your own computer capable of editing long HD basketball videos.



Who I’m Looking For



You should be:



A strong video editor

Fast and efficient

Reliable with deadlines

Detail-oriented

Comfortable receiving feedback and revisions

Able to communicate clearly in English

Able to work independently

Interested in a long-term position



Previous experience editing:



Basketball

Sports highlights

Recruiting videos

YouTube sports content



is strongly preferred.



Understanding basketball is a major advantage.



Schedule



Approximately 40 hours per week.



The schedule can be relatively flexible as long as projects are completed on time and communication is consistent.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction

Your video-editing experience

Links to your best 3–5 previous video projects

Any basketball or sports videos you have edited

The editing software you use

Your computer specifications

Your expected monthly salary

How many years you have been editing professionally



Please begin your application with “Vantage Editor” so I know you read the entire posting.



Applicants with strong basketball or sports-editing portfolios will receive priority.

title: AU Senior Tax Accountant
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE TO START ASAP WITH NO CURRENT EMPLOYMENT OR OTHER ENGAGEMENTS.**



ROLE SUMMARY:

Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS:

- CPA qualification is a requirement

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS:

Xero | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



BENEFITS:

- Work Setup: 100% remote

- Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Work Schedule: US business hours

- 13th Month Pay: Provided annually

- Health Benefits: HMO coverage

- Salary: NO salary deductions; full agreed compensation will be received



HOW TO APPLY:

Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your resume and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Operations Coordinator (Remote): Chimney
description:
We are a US-based chimney and air duct cleaning company. Our jobs are done by field subcontractors in several states. We're hiring an Operations Coordinator to run day-to-day operations. You'll make sure every lead gets contacted, every job gets done, and every problem gets solved.



This is not a "sit and wait for the phone" job. You'll own the daily job board. You'll chase customers who don't answer, follow up with subcontractors, fix problems before they grow, and keep the CRM accurate. You'll be on the phone and in WhatsApp all day with customers and techs, so clear, confident spoken English is required.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Customer follow-up

- Call and text customers who didn't answer, missed a callback, or haven't booked yet, and keep following up until they're booked or closed out

- Confirm upcoming appointments and reschedule cancellations and no-shows

- Handle customer complaints, delays, and questions about pricing and services using our scripts



Subcontractor management

- Dispatch jobs to subcontractors through our WhatsApp groups and make sure a tech accepts every job

- Contact subs about any problem: late arrival, no-show, job not closed, missing price or photos, customer complaint

- Make sure every completed job is closed in the CRM with the correct price, so nothing goes unbilled



Daily operations

- Start each day by reviewing open leads, scheduled jobs, and jobs that aren't closed yet in Workiz, and work the list until it's clean

- Act on missed-call and missed-lead alerts we send to

- Answer inbound calls through RingCentral when needed

- Escalate serious issues (damage, refunds, angry customers, sub disputes) to the owner with a short, clear summary

- Send a short end-of-day report covering jobs booked, jobs completed, open problems, and anything that needs the owner's attention



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent spoken and written English (we'll test this on the interview call)

- Experience in operations, dispatch, customer service, or as a virtual assistant for a service business. Home services or HVAC experience is a big plus.

- Proactive. You find problems and fix them without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable calling people back several times without being pushy

- Firm but respectful with subcontractors. You can hold them accountable.

- Organized and detail-oriented: clean CRM data, no loose ends

- Able to juggle many open jobs at once without dropping any

- Reliable home internet (10+ Mbps), a backup connection, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset

- Able to work US time zone hours



TOOLS YOU'LL USE (training provided)

- Workiz (CRM and job management)

- RingCentral (phone and SMS)

- WhatsApp (subcontractor groups)

-
 (internal alerts)



HOW TO APPLY

Please reply with:

1. Your experience handling operations, customer follow-up, or dispatch, and which tools you've used

3. Your internet speed (a screenshot from speedtest.net) and your home setup
